title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五: 世祖二
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五: 世祖二 Volume 5 Annals 5: Shizu 2

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸亥，修宣聖廟成。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on guihai day, the restoration of the Temple of the Sage was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on guihai day of the first month of spring, work on the Temple of the Sage was finished.

sentences.zh: 庚午，罷高麗互市。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the mutual market with Goryeo was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the border market with Goryeo was closed.

sentences.zh: 諸王塔察兒請置鐵冶，從之；

translations.literal: Prince Tachar requested the establishment of iron smelting works; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tachar asked to set up iron smelting works, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 請立互市，不從。

translations.literal: He requested the establishment of a mutual market; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to open a border market, but that was refused.

sentences.zh: 忽剌忽兒所部民饑，罷上供羊。

translations.literal: The people under Qulqul suffered famine; tribute sheep were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The people under Prince Qulqul were starving, so the court stopped collecting tribute sheep from them.

sentences.zh: 命銀冶戶七百、河南屯田戶百四十，賦稅輸之州縣。

translations.literal: Seven hundred silver-smelting households and one hundred forty Henan garrison-farming households were ordered to pay taxes and levies to their prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Seven hundred silver-smelting households and one hundred forty Henan garrison-farming households were ordered to pay taxes through their local prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 命匠戶為軍者仍為軍，其軍官當考第富貧，存恤無力者。

translations.literal: Artisan households serving as soldiers were ordered to remain soldiers; their military officers were to assess rich and poor ranks and provide relief to those without means.
translations.idiomatic: Artisan households already serving as soldiers were to remain in service. Their officers were to rank households by wealth and poverty and give relief to those who could not support themselves.

sentences.zh: 耶律鑄詣北京餉諸王軍，仍遣宣撫使柴禎等增價糴米三萬石益之。

translations.literal: Yelü Zhuo went to Beijing to supply the princes' armies, and Pacification Commissioner Chai Zhen and others were also dispatched to purchase at increased price thirty thousand shi of rice to supplement them.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Zhuo went to Beijing to provision the princes' armies, and Pacification Commissioner Chai Zhen and others were sent to buy thirty thousand shi of rice at premium prices as additional supplies.

sentences.zh: 賜高麗國歷。

translations.literal: The calendar was granted to the state of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted Goryeo the official calendar.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁諸道戍兵及勢家縱畜牧犯桑棗禾稼者。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, garrison soldiers on all circuits and powerful families were forbidden to graze livestock so as to damage mulberry, jujube, and grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict forbade garrison troops on every circuit and powerful households from grazing livestock in fields of mulberry, jujube, and grain.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以軍興人民勞苦，敕停公私逋負毋征。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, because the people had been worn down by military mobilization, an edict ordered that public and private arrears cease to be collected.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, citing the people's exhaustion from war mobilization, the Emperor ordered a halt to collecting public and private debts.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賜廣寧王爪都駝鈕金鍍銀印，及諸王合必赤行軍印。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Prince Guangning Jadu was granted a camel-button gold-plated silver seal, and Prince Qebek a field-campaign seal.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Prince Guangning Jadu received a camel-button gold-plated silver seal, and Prince Qebek a seal for field command.

sentences.zh: 宋制置使賈似道以書誘總管張元等，李亶獲其書上之。

translations.literal: Song Commissioner Jia Sidao sent letters to entice Commanders Zhang Yuan and others; Li Tan captured the letters and submitted them.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao, the Song commissioner, wrote letters trying to win over Commanders Zhang Yuan and others. Li Tan seized the letters and forwarded them to court.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命江漢大都督史權、亳州萬戶張弘彥將兵八千赴燕。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Great Governor of Jiang-Han Shi Quan and Bozhou Wanhu Zhang Hongyan were ordered to lead eight thousand troops to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Shi Quan, Great Governor of Jiang-Han, and Zhang Hongyan, wanhu of Bozhou, were ordered to march eight thousand men to Yan.

sentences.zh: 備宮懸鐘磬、樂舞、籥翟，凡用三百六十二人。

translations.literal: Palace suspended bells and chimes, music and dance, reed pipes and feathered dancers were prepared — three hundred sixty-two persons in all.
translations.idiomatic: The court prepared palace bells and chimes, dancers, reed pipes, and feathered performers — three hundred sixty-two people in all.

sentences.zh: 高麗遣使奉表來謝，優詔答之。

translations.literal: Goryeo dispatched envoys bearing a memorial to express thanks; a gracious edict replied to them.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys with a memorial of thanks, and the Emperor answered with a gracious edict.

sentences.zh: 李亶質子彥簡逃歸。

translations.literal: Li Tan's hostage son Yan Jian escaped and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Jian, Li Tan's son held at court as a hostage, fled home.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥朔，元籍軍竄名為民者，命有司還正之。

translations.literal: Second month, dinghai new moon: those originally registered as soldiers who had falsely registered as civilians were ordered restored to their proper status by the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the second month, men originally on the military rolls who had hidden themselves among civilians were ordered back onto the registers.

sentences.zh: 括諸道逃亡軍。

translations.literal: Deserters from all circuits were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: The court conscripted deserters from every circuit.

sentences.zh: 己丑，李亶反，以漣、海三城獻於宋，盡殺蒙古戍軍，引麾下趨益都。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Li Tan rebelled, ceded the three cities of Lian and Hai to the Song, killed all the Mongol garrison troops, and led his followers toward Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Li Tan rose in rebellion. He handed three cities in the Lian and Hai region to the Song, slaughtered every Mongol garrison soldier there, and marched his forces toward Yidu.

sentences.zh: 前宣撫副使王磐脫身走至濟南，驛召磐，令姚樞問計，磐對：「豎子狂妄，即成擒耳。

translations.literal: Former Deputy Pacification Commissioner Wang Pan escaped to Jinan. Summoned by courier, he was questioned for counsel by Yao Shu; Wang replied: "The foolish boy is arrogant — he will soon be captured."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Pan, former deputy pacification commissioner, had slipped away to Jinan. The Emperor summoned him by courier and had Yao Shu ask his counsel. Wang answered, "That arrogant fool will be taken in no time."

sentences.zh: 」帝然之。

translations.literal: The Emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宋兵攻新蔡。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Song troops attacked Xincai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Song forces attacked Xincai.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，始定中外官俸，命大司農姚樞講定條格。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, official salaries at court and in the provinces were first fixed, and Grand Minister of Agriculture Yao Shu was ordered to compile the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court first fixed official salaries at court and in the provinces and ordered Yao Shu, Grand Minister of Agriculture, to draft the regulations.

sentences.zh: 甲午，李亶入益都，發府庫犒其將校。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Li Tan entered Yidu and opened the treasury to reward his officers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Li Tan entered Yidu, opened the government stores, and rewarded his commanders.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔諸道以今歲民賦市馬。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, an edict ordered all circuits to use this year's civilian levies to purchase horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict ordered every circuit to use the year's civilian tax receipts to buy horses.

sentences.zh: 丙申，郭守敬造寶山漏成，徙至燕京。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Guo Shoujing completed the Baoshan water clock, and it was moved to Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Guo Shoujing finished the Baoshan clepsydra, which was then moved to Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 以興、松、雲三州隸上都。

translations.literal: Xing, Song, and Yun Prefectures were placed under the jurisdiction of Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Xing, Song, and Yun Prefectures were placed under Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李亶遣騎寇蒲臺。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Li Tan sent cavalry to raid Putai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Li Tan sent horsemen to raid Putai.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔發兵討之。

translations.literal: On guimao day, an edict ordered troops dispatched to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict ordered armies sent to crush the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 以趙璧為平章政事。

translations.literal: Zhao Bi was made Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bi was appointed grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 修深、冀、南宮、棗強四城。

translations.literal: The four cities of Shen, Ji, Nangong, and Zaoqiang were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Fortifications at Shen, Ji, Nangong, and Zaoqiang were repaired.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，發諸蒙古、漢軍討李亶，命水軍萬戶解成、張榮實、大名萬戶王文幹及萬戶嚴忠範會東平，濟南萬戶張宏、歸德萬戶邸浹、武衛軍炮手元帥薛軍勝等會濱棣，詔濟南路軍民萬戶張宏、濱棣路安撫使韓世安，各修城塹，盡發管內民為兵以備。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Mongol and Han armies were dispatched to suppress Li Tan. Naval Wanhu Jie Cheng and Zhang Rongshi, Daming Wanhu Wang Wengan, and Wanhu Yan Zhongfan were ordered to assemble at Dongping; Jinan Wanhu Zhang Hong, Guide Wanhu Di Jia, and Wuwei Army catapult marshal Xue Junsheng and others were ordered to assemble at Bin-Di. An edict ordered Jinan Circuit Military-Civilian Wanhu Zhang Hong and Bin-Di Circuit Pacification Commissioner Han Shi'an each to repair walls and moats and mobilize all people within their jurisdictions as soldiers for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Mongol and Han forces marched against Li Tan. The naval commanders Jie Cheng and Zhang Rongshi, Daming wanhu Wang Wengan, and wanhu Yan Zhongfan were to gather at Dongping; Jinan wanhu Zhang Hong, Guide wanhu Di Jia, and Wuwei Army catapult marshal Xue Junsheng and others were to gather in Bin-Di. Zhang Hong, military-civilian wanhu of Jinan, and Han Shi'an, pacification commissioner of Bin-Di, were each ordered to repair walls and ditches and draft every man under their jurisdiction for defense.

sentences.zh: 召張柔及其子弘範率兵二千詣京師。

translations.literal: Zhang Rou and his son Zhang Hongfan were summoned to lead two thousand troops to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rou and his son Zhang Hongfan were called to the capital with two thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命諸王合必赤總督諸軍，以不只愛不幹及趙璧行中書省事於山東，宋子貞參議行中書省事，以董源、高逸民為左右司郎中，許便宜從事。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Prince Qebek was ordered to command all armies overall; Bojinai and Zhao Bi were to administer branch secretariat affairs in Shandong, Song Zizhen to serve as counsellor of branch secretariat affairs, and Dong Yuan and Gao Yimin as left and right bureau directors, granted discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince Qebek was placed in overall command of the armies. Bojinai and Zhao Bi were to run the branch secretariat in Shandong, Song Zizhen as its counsellor, and Dong Yuan and Gao Yimin as left and right bureau directors with authority to act as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 真定、順天、河間、平灤、大名、邢州、河南諸路兵皆會濟南。

translations.literal: Troops from the circuits of Zhending, Shuntian, Hejian, Pingluan, Daming, Xingzhou, and Henan all assembled at Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Forces from Zhending, Shuntian, Hejian, Pingluan, Daming, Xingzhou, and Henan all converged on Jinan.

sentences.zh: 以中書左丞闊闊、尚書怯烈門、宣撫遊顯行宣慰司於大名，洺滋、懷孟、彰德、衛輝、河南東西兩路皆隸焉。

translations.literal: Left Associate of the Central Secretariat Kuoku, Minister Qieliemen, and Pacification Commissioner You Xian were sent to administer the Pacification Commission at Daming; the Luozi, Huaizhou, Zhangde, Weihui, and eastern and western Henan circuits were all placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: Kuoku, left associate of the Central Secretariat, Qieliemen, minister of state, and Pacification Commissioner You Xian were sent to run the pacification commission at Daming, with the Luozi, Huaizhou, Zhangde, Weihui, and eastern and western Henan circuits placed under them.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王文統坐與李亶同謀伏誅，仍詔諭中外。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Wang Wentong was executed for plotting with Li Tan, and an edict was issued to inform the realm within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Wang Wentong was put to death for conspiring with Li Tan, and an edict announced the sentence throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 王演等以妖言誅。

translations.literal: Wang Yan and others were executed for seditious speech.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan and others were executed for spreading seditious talk.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，敕元帥阿海分兵戍平灤、海口及東京、廣寧、懿州，以余兵詣京師。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, an edict ordered Marshal Ahai to divide his troops to garrison Pingluan, Haikou, Dongjing, Guangning, and Yizhou, and bring the remaining troops to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Marshal Ahai was ordered to detach troops to garrison Pingluan, Haikou, Dongjing, Guangning, and Yizhou and to bring the rest of his force to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔諸道括逃軍還屯田，嚴其禁。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all circuits to conscript deserters back into garrison farming, with strict enforcement of the prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered every circuit to hunt down deserters and return them to garrison farming, with the ban strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 壬子，李亶據濟南。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Li Tan seized Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Li Tan took Jinan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔大名、洺滋、彰德、衛輝、懷孟、河南、真定、邢州、順天、河間、平灤諸路皆籍兵守城。

translations.literal: On guichou day, an edict ordered the circuits of Daming, Luozi, Zhangde, Weihui, Huaizhou, Henan, Zhending, Xingzhou, Shuntian, Hejian, and Pingluan all to register troops and garrison the cities.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ordered Daming, Luozi, Zhangde, Weihui, Huaizhou, Henan, Zhending, Xingzhou, Shuntian, Hejian, and Pingluan to register soldiers and man their city walls.

sentences.zh: 宋兵攻滕州。

translations.literal: Song troops attacked Tengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Song forces attacked Tengzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔拔都抹臺將息州戍兵詣濟南，移其民於蔡州，東平萬戶嚴忠範留兵戍宿州及蘄縣，以余兵自隨。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, an edict ordered Badu Motai to lead the Xizhou garrison troops to Jinan and move its people to Caizhou; Dongping Wanhu Yan Zhongfan was to leave troops to garrison Suzhou and Qixian and follow with the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Badu Motai was ordered to take the Xizhou garrison to Jinan and relocate its people to Caizhou. Yan Zhongfan, wanhu of Dongping, was to leave troops at Suzhou and Qixian and march with the rest.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，有旨：「非中書省文移及兵民官申省者，不許入遞。

translations.literal: Third month, wuwu day, an imperial directive stated: "Documents not from the Central Secretariat, and reports to the Secretariat not submitted by military-civilian officials, are not permitted to enter the courier system."
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the third month the Emperor directed that only Central Secretariat documents and submissions from military-civilian officials to the Secretariat might enter the courier system.

sentences.zh: 」己未，括木速蠻、畏吾兒、也裏可溫、答失蠻等戶丁為兵。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, household males of Muslims, Uighurs, Nestorian Christians, Dasman, and others were conscripted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day males from Muslim, Uighur, Nestorian Christian, Dasman, and other registered households were drafted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 庚申，括北京鷹坊等戶丁為兵，蠲其賦，令趙炳將之。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, household males of the Beijing falconry offices and related households were conscripted as soldiers, their levies were remitted, and Zhao Bing was ordered to command them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day males from the Beijing falconry offices and related households were drafted as soldiers, exempted from levies, and placed under Zhao Bing's command.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，宗拔突言河南有自願從軍者，命即令將之。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Zongbatu reported that in Henan there were men willing to enlist voluntarily; they were ordered immediately placed under command.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Zongbatu reported volunteers for military service in Henan, and they were ordered enlisted at once.

sentences.zh: 遣鄭鼎、贍思丁、答裏帶、三島行宣慰司事於平陽、太原。

translations.literal: Zheng Ding, Shams al-Din, Dalidai, and San-dao were dispatched to administer pacification affairs at Pingyang and Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Ding, Shams al-Din, Dalidai, and San-dao were sent to administer pacification at Pingyang and Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 簽見任民官及捕鷹坊、人匠等軍。

translations.literal: Currently serving civilian officials, falconry households, artisan households, and others were drafted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Serving civilian officials together with falconry and artisan households were drafted into the army.

sentences.zh: 徙弘州錦工繡女於京師。

translations.literal: Hongzhou brocade workers and embroiderers were moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Brocade workers and embroiderers from Hongzhou were relocated to the capital.

sentences.zh: 敕河東兩路元括金州兵付鄭鼎將之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the previously conscripted Jinzhou troops of the two Hedong circuits placed under Zheng Ding's command.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed the Jinzhou troops previously drafted from the two Hedong circuits under Zheng Ding's command.

sentences.zh: 詔以平章政事祃祃、廉希憲，參政商挺，斷事官麥肖，行中書省於陜西、四川。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Grand Councillors Mamma and Lian Xixian, Vice Councillor Shang Ting, and Judicial Officer Maixiao to administer the branch secretariat in Shaanxi and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Grand Councillors Mamma and Lian Xixian, Vice Councillor Shang Ting, and judicial officer Maixiao to run the branch secretariat in Shaanxi and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 獲私商南界者四十餘人，命釋之。

translations.literal: More than forty private merchants caught at the southern frontier were ordered released.
translations.idiomatic: More than forty private merchants seized at the southern border were ordered released.

sentences.zh: 敕燕京至濟南置海青驛凡八所。

translations.literal: An edict ordered eight gyrfalcon courier stations established between Yanjing and Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established eight gyrfalcon relay stations between Yanjing and Jinan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命戶部尚書劉肅專職鈔法，平章政事賽典赤兼領之。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Households Minister Liu Su was assigned sole responsibility for paper currency law, with Grand Councillor Sayyid Ajall concurrently overseeing it.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Liu Su, minister of households, was put in charge of paper currency regulations, with Grand Councillor Sayyid Ajall concurrently supervising the work.

sentences.zh: 以撒吉思、柴楨行宣慰司事於北京。

translations.literal: Sags and Chai Zhen were sent to administer pacification affairs at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Sags and Chai Zhen were dispatched to run pacification affairs at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 免今歲絲銀，止輸田租。

translations.literal: This year's silk and silver levies were remitted; only land rent was to be paid.
translations.idiomatic: Silk and silver levies for the year were waived; only land rent was collected.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命史樞、阿術各將兵赴濟南。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Shi Shu and Aju were each ordered to lead troops to Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Shi Shu and Aju were each ordered to march on Jinan.

sentences.zh: 遇李亶軍，邀擊，大破之，斬首四千，亶退保濟南。

translations.literal: They encountered Li Tan's army, intercepted and routed it, beheaded four thousand, and Tan retreated to hold Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: They met Li Tan's army, cut them off, and routed them, taking four thousand heads. Li Tan fell back to defend Jinan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宋將夏貴攻符離。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Song General Xia Gui attacked Fuli.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Song general Xia Gui attacked Fuli.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，萬戶韓世安率鎮撫馬興、千戶張濟民，大破李亶兵於高苑，獲其權府傅珪，賜濟民、興金符。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Wanhu Han Shi'an, leading Pacification Commissioner Ma Xing and Qianhu Zhang Jimin, routed Li Tan's army at Gaoyuan, captured his provisional governor Fu Gui, and granted Zhang Jimin and Ma Xing gold tally tokens.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Han Shi'an, wanhu, with Pacification Commissioner Ma Xing and qianhu Zhang Jimin, crushed Li Tan's force at Gaoyuan, captured his acting prefect Fu Gui, and awarded Zhang Jimin and Ma Xing gold tally tokens.

sentences.zh: 詔以李亶兵敗諭諸路。

translations.literal: An edict announced Li Tan's defeat to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: An edict reported Li Tan's defeat to every circuit.

sentences.zh: 禁民間私藏軍器。

translations.literal: Private possession of military weapons by the people was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The people were forbidden to keep military weapons in private hands.

sentences.zh: 壬午，始以畏吾字書給驛璽書。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Uighur script was first used for courier imperial seals and documents.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Uighur script was first used on imperial seals and documents sent by courier.

sentences.zh: 免西京今年絲銀稅。

translations.literal: Xijing's silk and silver taxes for this year were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Silk and silver taxes at Xijing were waived for the year.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免高麗酒課。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Goryeo liquor taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Goryeo's liquor tax was waived.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，宋夏貴攻蘄縣。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Song Xia Gui attacked Qixian.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Xia Gui of the Song attacked Qixian.

sentences.zh: 諭諸路管民官，毋令軍馬、使臣入州城、村居、鎮市，擾及良民。

translations.literal: Officials governing the people on all circuits were instructed not to allow armies, envoys, and others to enter prefectural cities, villages, or market towns and disturb peaceful civilians.
translations.idiomatic: Officials on every circuit were told not to let armies, envoys, or other parties enter prefectural cities, villages, or market towns and harass the people.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，大軍樹柵鑿塹，圍亶於濟南。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, bingwu new moon: the great army erected palisades and dug trenches, besieging Tan at Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the fourth month of summer the main army threw up palisades and trenches and besieged Li Tan in Jinan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔博興、高苑等處軍民嘗為李亶脅從者，並釋其罪。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, an edict ordered that military and civilian personnel in Boxing, Gaoyuan, and other places who had once been coerced into following Li Tan were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict pardoned soldiers and civilians in Boxing, Gaoyuan, and elsewhere who had been forced to follow Li Tan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命怯烈門、安撫張耕分邢州戶隸兩答剌罕。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Qieliemen and Pacification Commissioner Zhang Geng were ordered to divide Xingzhou households between two darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Qieliemen and Pacification Commissioner Zhang Geng were ordered to split Xingzhou households between two darughachi.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，修河中禹廟，賜名建極宮。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the Yu Temple at Hezhong was restored and granted the name Jianji Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Yu Temple at Hezhong was restored and renamed Jianji Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以大梁府渠州路軍民總帥蒲元圭為東夔路經略使。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Pu Yuangui, commander of military and civilian affairs of the Daliang-Luzhou Circuit, was made Military Commissioner of the Eastern Kui Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Pu Yuangui, commander of military and civilian affairs of the Daliang-Luzhou circuit, was appointed military commissioner of the Eastern Kui circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙申，宋華路分、湯太尉攻徐、邳二州。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Song commanders Hua Lufen and Grand Marshal Tang attacked Xu and Pi Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Song commanders Hua Lufen and Grand Marshal Tang attacked Xu and Pi Prefectures.

sentences.zh: 詔分張柔軍千人還戍亳州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered one thousand of Zhang Rou's troops returned to garrison Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent one thousand of Zhang Rou's men back to garrison Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，江漢大都督史權以趙百戶潔眾逃歸，斬之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Jiang-Han Great Governor Shi Quan executed Zhao Baihu and his followers for deserting and returning.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Shi Quan, Great Governor of Jiang-Han, executed Zhao Baihu and his men for desertion.

sentences.zh: 詔：「自今部曲犯重罪，鞫問得實，必先奏聞，然後置諸法。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "From now on, when retainers commit serious crimes and interrogation establishes the facts, a report must first be submitted to the throne before legal punishment is applied."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared, "Henceforth, when retainers commit capital offenses and inquiry proves the charge, the case must first be reported to the throne before sentence is carried out."

sentences.zh: 」詔安輯徐、邳民，禁征戍軍士及勢官，毋縱畜牧傷其禾稼桑棗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the people of Xu and Pi settled, forbidding garrison troops and powerful officials from grazing livestock so as to damage their grain crops, mulberry, and jujube.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered the people of Xu and Pi resettled and forbade garrison soldiers and powerful officials from grazing livestock over their grain, mulberry, and jujube.

sentences.zh: 以米千石、牛三百給西京蒙古戶。

translations.literal: One thousand shi of rice and three hundred oxen were given to Mongol households at Xijing.
translations.idiomatic: The court gave one thousand shi of rice and three hundred oxen to Mongol households at Xijing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，宋兵攻亳州。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Song troops attacked Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Song forces attacked Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命行中書省、宣慰司、諸路達魯花赤、管民官，勸誘百姓，開墾田土，種植桑棗，不得擅興不急之役，妨奪農時。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the branch secretariat, pacification commissions, darughachi on all circuits, and officials governing the people were ordered to encourage the people to open and cultivate land, plant mulberry and jujube, and not to undertake unauthorized non-urgent corvée that would interfere with the farming season.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the branch secretariat, pacification commissions, circuit darughachi, and civilian officials were ordered to encourage farming, mulberry planting, and jujube cultivation, and not to impose unauthorized non-urgent labor that would steal time from the fields.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以北京、廣寧、豪、懿州軍興勞弊，免今歲稅賦。

translations.literal: On yisi day, because Beijing, Guangning, Hao, and Yizhou had been worn down by military mobilization, this year's taxes and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Beijing, Guangning, Hao, and Yizhou were exempted from the year's taxes and levies because war mobilization had exhausted them.

sentences.zh: 命諸路詳讞冤獄。

translations.literal: Officials on all circuits were ordered to review wrongful convictions carefully.
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit was ordered to review cases of wrongful conviction with care.

sentences.zh: 詔河東兩路並平陽、太原路達魯花赤及兵民官，撫安軍民，各安生業，毋失歲計。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the two Hedong circuits together with the darughachi and military-civilian officials of Pingyang and Taiyuan to pacify soldiers and civilians, each maintaining livelihood without missing the year's quotas.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the two Hedong circuits and the darughachi and military-civilian officials of Pingyang and Taiyuan to settle troops and people in their occupations without missing the year's revenue targets.

sentences.zh: 丁未，李亶遣柴牛兒招諭部民盧廣，廣縛以獻，殺之；

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Li Tan sent Chai Niuer to summon the local man Lu Guang; Guang bound and presented him, then killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Li Tan sent Chai Niuer to win over the local man Lu Guang. Guang seized Niuer, handed him over, and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 以廣權威州軍判，兼捕盜官。

translations.literal: Guang was made Acting Military Judge of Weizhou and concurrently bandit-catcher.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Guang was appointed acting military judge of Weizhou and bandit-catcher as well.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜諸王也相哥金印。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Prince Yeshangge was granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Prince Yeshangge received a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賜諸王合必赤金銀海青符各二。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Prince Qebek was granted two gold and silver gyrfalcon tokens each.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Prince Qebek received two gold and two silver gyrfalcon courier tokens.

sentences.zh: 免松州、興州、望雲州新舊差賦，以望雲、松山、興州課程隸開平府。

translations.literal: New and old levies at Songzhou, Xingzhou, and Wangyunzhou were remitted; the revenues of Wangyun, Songshan, and Xingzhou were placed under Kaiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Old and new levies at Songzhou, Xingzhou, and Wangyunzhou were waived, and revenues from Wangyun, Songshan, and Xingzhou were assigned to Kaiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬子，敕非軍情毋行望雲驛。

translations.literal: On renzi day, an edict ordered that unless there was a military emergency, the Wangyun courier station was not to be used.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict forbade use of the Wangyun relay station except in military emergencies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，河南路王豁子、張無僧、杜信等謀為不軌，並伏誅。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Wang Huozi, Zhang Wuseng, Du Xin, and others of Henan Circuit plotted sedition and were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Wang Huozi, Zhang Wuseng, Du Xin, and others in Henan Circuit were executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 詔右丞相史天澤專征，諸將皆受節度。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Right Grand Councillor Shi Tianze to command the campaign exclusively; all generals were to accept his orders.
translations.idiomatic: An edict put Right Grand Councillor Shi Tianze in sole field command, with every general under his authority.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，蘄縣陷，權萬戶李義、千戶張好古死之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuwu day: Qixian fell; Acting Wanhu Li Yi and Qianhu Zhang Haogu died in its defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the fifth month Qixian fell. Acting wanhu Li Yi and qianhu Zhang Haogu died defending it.

sentences.zh: 庚申，築環城圍濟南，亶不復得出。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, an encircling wall was built around Jinan; Tan could no longer get out.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day a ring wall was thrown up around Jinan, and Li Tan was trapped inside.

sentences.zh: 詔撒吉思安撫益都路百姓，各務農功，仍禁蒙古、漢軍剽掠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sags to pacify the people of Yidu Circuit, each devoting themselves to farming, while forbidding Mongol and Han troops from plundering.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Sags to settle the people of Yidu Circuit and keep them at their farming, while forbidding Mongol and Han soldiers from looting.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，史權妄奏徐、邳總管李杲哥完復邳州城，詔由杲哥以下並原其罪。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Shi Quan falsely reported that Xu-Pi Commander Li Gaoge had recovered Pizhou; an edict pardoned Li Gaoge and those below him.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Shi Quan falsely reported that Li Gaoge, commander of Xu and Pi, had retaken Pizhou. An edict pardoned Li Gaoge and his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 時宋將夏貴攻邳州，杲哥出降，貴既去，杲哥自陳能保全州城，史權以聞，故有是命。

translations.literal: At that time Song General Xia Gui was attacking Pizhou; Gaoge surrendered. After Gui departed, Gaoge declared that he had been able to preserve the prefectural city; Shi Quan reported this, hence the order.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Song general Xia Gui was attacking Pizhou and Li Gaoge surrendered. After Xia Gui withdrew, Li Gaoge claimed he had kept the city intact. Shi Quan reported this, which led to the pardon.

sentences.zh: 甲子，宋兵攻利津縣。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Song troops attacked Lijin County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Song forces attacked Lijin County.

sentences.zh: 蠲濱棣今歲田租之半，東平蠲十之三。

translations.literal: Half of this year's field-rent tax was remitted in Bin-Di; Dongping's remission was three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's field rents in Bin-Di were remitted; Dongping's exemption was set at three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 自燕至開平立牛驛，給鈔市車牛。

translations.literal: Ox relays were established from Yan to Kaiping; paper money was issued to purchase cart oxen.
translations.idiomatic: Relay stations for draft oxen were set up from Yan to Kaiping, and notes were issued to buy cart cattle.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以左丞相忽魯不花兼中書省都斷事官，賜虎符。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Left Grand Councillor Qur Qosa was made concurrent chief judicial officer of the Central Secretariat and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Left Grand Councillor Qur Qosa was appointed concurrent chief judicial officer of the Secretariat and given a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 真定、順天、邢州蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts struck Zhending, Shuntian, and Xing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts plagued Zhending, Shuntian, and Xing.

sentences.zh: 以平章政事賽典赤兼領工部及諸路工作，以孟烈所獻蹶張弩藏於中都。

translations.literal: Sayid Ajall, Vice Grand Councillor, was also placed in charge of the Works Ministry and construction throughout the circuits; the foot-drawn crossbow Meng Lie presented was stored at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councillor Sayid Ajall was additionally put in charge of the Works Ministry and public works in every circuit; the powerful crossbow Meng Lie had submitted was stored at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙子，縉山至望雲立海青驛。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, sea-eagle relays were established from Jinshan to Wangyun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day courier relays—the sea-eagle post—were opened from Jinshan to Wangyun.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，李杲哥等伏誅，命史天澤選考徐、邳總管。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Li Guoge and others were executed; Shi Tianze was ordered to select and assess the zongguan of Xu and Pi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Li Guoge and his accomplices were executed, and Shi Tianze was ordered to choose and evaluate a new commander for Xu and Pi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，真定路不眼裏海牙擅殺造偽鈔者三人，詔詰其違制之罪。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Bulaihaiya of Zhending Circuit had on his own authority executed three counterfeiters of paper notes; an edict inquired into his crime of violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Bulaihaiya of Zhending circuit had summarily executed three makers of forged notes; an edict demanded an account of his breach of protocol.

sentences.zh: 西京、宣德、威寧、龍門霜，順天、平陽、河南、真定雨雹，東平、濱棣旱。

translations.literal: Frost at Xijing, Xuande, Weining, and Longmen; hail at Shuntian, Pingyang, Henan, and Zhending; drought at Dongping and Bin-Di.
translations.idiomatic: Frost damaged crops at Xijing, Xuande, Weining, and Longmen; hail fell at Shuntian, Pingyang, Henan, and Zhending; Dongping and Bin-Di suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 詔核實逃戶、輸納絲銀稅租戶，口增者賞之，隱匿者罪之，逃民茍免差稅重加之罪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered verification of fugitive households and of households paying silk-silver tax and rent; increase in registered population was to be rewarded and concealment punished; fugitive commoners who evaded corvée and taxes faced additional penalties.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a census of fugitive households and of those paying silk, silver, and land tax—growth in registered mouths was to be rewarded, concealment punished, and runaways who dodged levy and tax were to face heavier penalties still.

sentences.zh: 大司農姚樞辭赴省議事，帝勉留之，命樞與左三部尚書劉肅依前商議中書省事。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Agriculture Yao Shu declined to go to the Secretariat for deliberations; the Emperor urged him to remain and ordered Shu and Liu Su, Minister of the Left Three Departments, to continue deliberating Secretariat affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Agriculture Yao Shu begged off attending Secretariat deliberations; Kublai pressed him to stay and told him and Liu Su, minister of the Left Three Departments, to keep handling Secretariat business as before.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉朔，宋兵攻滄州、雅州、瀘山，民既降復叛，命誅其首亂者七人，余令安業。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yiyou new moon, Song troops attacked Cangzhou, Yazhou, and Lushan; the people had surrendered then rebelled again — seven ringleaders were ordered executed, the rest told to resume their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the sixth month Song forces struck Cangzhou, Yazhou, and Lushan. The populace had submitted and then risen again; seven chief instigators were put to death, the remainder ordered back to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 割遼河以東隸開元路。

translations.literal: Territory east of the Liao River was severed and placed under Kaiyuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Land east of the Liao River was detached and assigned to Kaiyuan circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊子，濱棣安撫使韓世安敗宋兵於濱州丁河口。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Han Shi'an, pacification commissioner of Bin-Di, defeated Song troops at the Dinghe mouth in Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Han Shi'an, pacification commissioner of Bin-Di, routed Song forces at the Dinghe estuary in Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣塔察兒帥兵擊宋軍，仍安諭瀕海軍民。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Tachar was dispatched to lead troops against the Song army and also to reassure coastal military and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Tachar was sent at the head of an army against the Song and to pacify the coastal garrisons and people.

sentences.zh: 乙未，禁女直侵軼高麗國民，其使臣往還，官為護送。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Jurchen encroachment on the people of Goryeo was forbidden; envoys traveling back and forth were to be escorted by officials.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Jurchen raids against Goryeo subjects were banned, and Goryeo envoys in transit were to be escorted by officials.

sentences.zh: 送婆娑府屯田軍移駐鴨綠江之西，以防海道。

translations.literal: The garrison-farm troops of Sapo Prefecture were moved west of the Yalu River to guard the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: Sapo's garrison-farming troops were transferred west of the Yalu to watch the sea lanes.

sentences.zh: 丙申，高麗國王王禃遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，陜西行省言西京、宣德、太原匠軍困乏，乞以民代之。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported that artisan-soldiers at Xijing, Xuande, and Taiyuan were exhausted and asked that civilians replace them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Shaanxi branch secretariat reported that artisan-troops at Xijing, Xuande, and Taiyuan were worn out and asked to substitute civilians in their place.

sentences.zh: 有旨：「軍籍已定，不宜動搖，宜令貧富相資，果甚貧者，令休息一歲。

translations.literal: An order stated: "Military registers are fixed and should not be disturbed; the rich and poor should support one another; those truly destitute may rest one year."
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered: "Army rolls are set—do not disturb them. Let rich and poor aid each other; those in real want may stand down for a year."

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，太原總管李毅奴哥、達魯花赤戴曲薛等領李亶偽檄，傳行旁郡，事覺誅之。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Li Yinuge, zongguan of Taiyuan, and the darughachi Daiquxue and others, having circulated Li Tan's forged proclamation through neighboring prefectures, were discovered and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Li Yinuge, commander of Taiyuan, and the darughachi Daiquxue and others—caught spreading Li Tan's forged summons through neighboring prefectures—were put to death.

sentences.zh: 敕寧武軍歲輸所產鐵。

translations.literal: Ningwu Army was ordered to submit annually the iron it produced.
translations.idiomatic: Ningwu Army was ordered to deliver its iron output to the state each year.

sentences.zh: 河西民及諸王忽撒吉所部軍士乏食，給鈔賑之。

translations.literal: Civilians in Hexi and soldiers under Prince Husaji lacked food; paper money was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: People in Hexi and soldiers of Prince Husaji's command were starving; notes were issued for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，申嚴軍官及兵伍擾民之禁。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the prohibition on military officers and soldiers harassing civilians was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the ban on officers and troops molesting civilians was sharply reinforced.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立小峪、蘆子、寧武軍、赤泥泉鐵冶四所。

translations.literal: On guichou day, four ironworks were established at Xiaoyu, Luzi, Ningwu Army, and Chiniquan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day ironworks were opened at Xiaoyu, Luzi, Ningwu Army, and Chiniquan.

sentences.zh: 東平嚴忠濟向為民貸錢輸賦四十三萬七千四百錠，借用課程、鈔本、鹽課銀萬五千餘兩，詔勿征。

translations.literal: Yan Zhongji of Dongping had borrowed from the people money to pay taxes totaling 437,400 ingots, and had also borrowed more than 15,000 taels of silver from revenue, note capital, and salt levy; an edict ordered these not collected.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhongji of Dongping had raised 437,400 ingots in taxes by borrowing from the populace and had drawn more than 15,000 taels of silver from revenue, note reserves, and the salt tax; an edict remitted all of it.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，復蒙古軍站戶差賦，農民包銀征其半，俘戶止令輸絲，民當輸賦之月，毋征私債。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuwu day, corvée and tax obligations were restored for Mongol army relay households; the lump-sum silver payment of peasant households was halved; captive households were required to pay only silk; in months when people owed taxes, private debts were not to be collected.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the seventh month of autumn corvée and taxes were restored for Mongol relay households; peasants' lump-sum silver dues were cut in half; captive households owed only silk; and in tax months private debts could not be collected.

sentences.zh: 敕私市金銀應支錢物，止以鈔為準。

translations.literal: For gold and silver sold on the private market, payment was to be reckoned in paper notes only.
translations.idiomatic: Private trade in gold and silver was to be settled in notes alone.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賜夔州路行省楊大淵金符十、銀符十九，賞麾下將士；

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Yang Dayuan of the Qizhou Branch Secretariat was granted ten gold tally tokens and nineteen silver tally tokens to reward the officers and soldiers under his command;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Yang Dayuan of the Qizhou branch secretariat received ten gold tallies and nineteen silver tallies to reward his officers and men;

sentences.zh: 別給海青符二，事有急速，馳以上聞。

translations.literal: two sea-eagle tally tokens were separately granted — for urgent matters one might ride post-haste to report upward.
translations.idiomatic: two sea-eagle tallies besides, so that urgent reports could be rushed up the chain by relay.

sentences.zh: 立槍桿嶺驛，以便轉輸。

translations.literal: A relay was established at Qianggan Ridge to facilitate transport.
translations.idiomatic: A relay station was opened at Qianggan Ridge to speed supply runs.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，甘州饑，給銀以賑之。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Gan Prefecture suffered famine; silver was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Gan Prefecture was starving; silver was sent for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，李亶窮蹙，入大明湖，投水中不即死，獲之，並蒙古軍囊家伏誅，體解以徇。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Li Tan, hard pressed, entered Daming Lake; he threw himself into the water but did not die immediately; he was captured, and the Mongol soldier Nangia was executed with him; their bodies were dismembered and displayed as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Li Tan, driven to the wall, fled into Daming Lake and threw himself into the water but did not drown at once. He was taken alive; the Mongol soldier Nangia was executed with him, and both corpses were cut apart and paraded as a warning.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以夔府行省劉整行中書省於成都、潼川兩路，仍賜銀萬兩，分給軍士之失業者。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Liu Zheng of the Kuifu Branch Secretariat was put in charge of the Central Secretariat for Chengdu and Tongchuan circuits; ten thousand taels of silver were also granted and distributed to soldiers who had lost their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Liu Zheng of the Kuifu branch secretariat was made acting head of the Secretariat for Chengdu and Tongchuan; ten thousand taels of silver were also granted and paid out to soldiers left without livelihood.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，郭守敬請開玉泉水以通漕運，廣濟河渠司王允中請開邢、洺等處漳、滏、澧河、達泉以溉民田，並從之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Guo Shoujing requested opening Jade Spring to connect the grain transport; Wang Yunzhong of the Guangji River and Canal Office requested opening the Zhang, Fu, Li rivers and Da Spring in Xing, Ming, and elsewhere to irrigate farmland — both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the eighth month Guo Shoujing asked to tap Jade Spring for the grain route; Wang Yunzhong of the Guangji river-and-canal office asked to open the Zhang, Fu, Li, and Da Spring in Xing, Ming, and neighboring districts to water farmlands—both requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，博都歡等奏請以宣德州、德興府等處銀冶付其匠戶，歲取銀及石綠、丹粉輸官，從之。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Bodughan and others memorialized requesting that silver mines at Xuande Prefecture, Dexing Prefecture, and elsewhere be entrusted to artisan households, with silver, malachite, and cinnabar submitted annually to the government — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Bodughan and others asked that the Xuande and Dexing silver works be turned over to registered artisan households, delivering silver, malachite, and vermilion to the state each year—the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，立諸路醫學教授。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, medical instructors were established in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day instructors of medicine were appointed in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊申，敕王鶚集廷臣商榷史事，鶚等乞以先朝事跡錄付史館。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Wang E was ordered to gather court ministers to discuss historical matters; E and others requested that records of the previous reign be deposited with the History Office.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Wang E was told to assemble ministers to debate historical matters; he and his colleagues asked that materials on the prior reign be turned over to the historiography office.

sentences.zh: 河間、平灤、廣寧、西京、宣德、北京隕霜害稼。

translations.literal: Frost fell and damaged crops in Hejian, Pingluan, Guangning, Xijing, Xuande, and Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Killing frost struck Hejian, Pingluan, Guangning, Xijing, Xuande, and Beijing.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，亳州萬戶張弘略破宋兵於蘄縣，復宿、蘄二城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuwu day, Zhang Honglue, wanhu of Bozhou, defeated Song troops at Qi County and recovered Su and Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the ninth month Zhang Honglue, wanhu of Bozhou, broke Song forces at Qi County and retook Su and Qi.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛親軍都指揮使董文炳兼山東路經略使，收集益都舊軍充武衛軍，戍南邊，詔益都行省大都督撒吉思與董文炳會議兵民籍，每十戶惟取其二充武衛軍；

translations.literal: Dong Wenbing, commander of the Imperial Guard, was made concurrent Eastern Shandong Military Commissioner; old troops of Yidu were gathered as the Wuwei Guard to garrison the south; an edict ordered Grand Governor Sagis of the Yidu Branch Secretariat and Dong Wenbing to confer on military and civilian registers — of every ten households only two were to serve in the Wuwei Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Dong Wenbing, commander of the Imperial Guard, was also named military commissioner of eastern Shandong; surviving Yidu troops were mustered into the Wuwei guard for frontier duty. Sagis, grand governor of the Yidu branch secretariat, and Dong Wenbing were ordered to sort military and civilian registers—two households in ten were to be taken for the Wuwei guard;

sentences.zh: 其海州、東海、漣水移入益都者，亦隸本衛。

translations.literal: those transferred from Haizhou, Donghai, and Lianshui into Yidu were also placed under this guard.
translations.idiomatic: transfers from Haizhou, Donghai, and Lianshui into Yidu were placed under the same command.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷霸州海青驛。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the sea-eagle relay at Bazhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the sea-eagle relay at Bazhou was shut down.

sentences.zh: 安南國陳光丙遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Tran Quang Binh of Annam sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Tran Quang Binh of Annam sent envoys with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改邢州為順德府，立安撫司，洺、磁、威三州隸焉。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Xing Prefecture was renamed Shunde Prefecture and a pacification commission was established; Ming, Ci, and Wei prefectures were placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Xing Prefecture was raised to Shunde Prefecture with a pacification office; Ming, Ci, and Wei were attached to it.

sentences.zh: 聽太原民食小鹽，歲輸銀七千五百兩。

translations.literal: The people of Taiyuan were permitted to consume small salt, paying seven thousand five hundred taels of silver annually.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan people were allowed to use petty salt on payment of seven thousand five hundred taels of silver a year.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以馬月合乃餉軍功，授禮部尚書，賜金符。

translations.literal: On jisi day, for supplying the army, Ma Yuehenai was appointed Minister of Rites and granted a gold tally token.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Ma Yuehenai, rewarded for provisioning the army, was made minister of rites and given a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 壬申，授安南國王陳光丙及達魯花赤訥剌丁虎符。

translations.literal: On renshen day, King Tran Quang Binh of Annam and the darughachi Nala Ding were granted tiger tallies.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day King Tran Quang Binh of Annam and the darughachi Nala Ding received tiger tallies.

sentences.zh: 敕濟南官吏，凡軍民公私逋負，權閣毋征。

translations.literal: Jinan officials were ordered: all public and private arrears owed by military and civilians were temporarily suspended from collection.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan officials were told to hold in abeyance every public and private debt owed by soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，都元帥闊闊帶卒於軍，以其兄阿術代之，授虎符，將南邊蒙古、漢軍。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Grand Commander Köke Temür died in camp; his elder brother Aju was appointed in his stead, granted a tiger tally, and placed in command of Mongol and Han troops on the southern front.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Grand Commander Köke Temür died on campaign; his elder brother Aju replaced him, received a tiger tally, and took command of Mongol and Han forces on the southern front.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲申朔，沙、肅二州乏食，給米、鈔賑之。

translations.literal: On the jiashen new moon of the intercalary month, Sha and Su prefectures lacked food; rice and paper money were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the intercalary month Sha and Su ran short of grain; rice and notes were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，立古北口驛。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, a relay was established at Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day a relay was opened at Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，濟南民饑，免其賦稅。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the people of Jinan were starving; their taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Jinan was famine-struck; taxes there were remitted.

sentences.zh: 免諸路軍戶他徭。

translations.literal: Other corvée obligations for military households throughout the circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All other levy duties on military households in every circuit were waived.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，敕京師順州至開平置六驛。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, an order established six relays from Shun Prefecture in the capital region to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day six relay stations were set between Shun Prefecture in the capital region and Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，嚴忠範奏請補東平路廟學太常樂工，從之。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Yan Zhongfan memorialized requesting to fill posts for temple-school and Court of Imperial Sacrifices musicians in Dongping Circuit — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yan Zhongfan asked to fill vacancies for temple-school and imperial-sacrifice musicians in Dongping circuit—the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 敕武衛軍及黑軍會於京師。

translations.literal: The Wuwei Guard and the Black Army were ordered to assemble at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuwei guard and the Black Army were ordered to muster at the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，中翼千戶九住破宋兵於虎腦山。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Jiuzhu, qianhu of the Middle Wing, defeated Song troops at Hunao Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jiuzhu, qianhu of the middle wing, routed Song troops at Hunao Mountain.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，發粟三十萬石賑濟南饑民。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, three hundred thousand shi of grain was issued to relieve the starving people of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day three hundred thousand shi of grain was opened to feed Jinan's hungry.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，放金州所屯軍士二千人及大名、河南新簽防城軍為民。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingchen day, two thousand garrison soldiers at Jin Prefecture and newly drafted wall-defense troops of Daming and Henan were released to civilian status.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the tenth month of winter two thousand troops garrisoning Jin Prefecture and newly levied wall-guards of Daming and Henan were mustered out as civilians.

sentences.zh: 庚申，分益都軍民為二，董文炳領軍，撒吉思治民。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Yidu's military and civilians were split in two — Dong Wenbing led the army, Sagis governed the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Yidu's soldiers and civilians were divided: Dong Wenbing took the army, Sagis the civil administration.

sentences.zh: 禁諸王、使臣、師旅敢有恃勢擾民者，所在執以聞。

translations.literal: Princes, envoys, and armies who dared rely on their power to harass civilians were to be seized wherever found and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Any prince, envoy, or army that used its standing to bully the people was to be arrested on the spot and reported.

sentences.zh: 詔以李亶所掠民馬還其主。

translations.literal: An edict ordered horses Li Tan had plundered from civilians returned to their owners.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded that horses Li Tan had seized from the people be returned to their owners.

sentences.zh: 以郝經、劉人傑使宋未還，廩其家。

translations.literal: Because Hao Jing and Liu Renjie, envoys to Song, had not returned, their families were granted grain stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hao Jing and Liu Renjie, still abroad as envoys to Song, had not come back, their households were put on official grain allowance.

sentences.zh: 中書省奏與宋互市，庶止私商，及復逋民之陷於宋者，且覘漣、海二州，不允。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized proposing trade with Song to stop private merchants, restore fugitive civilians trapped in Song, and reconnoiter Lian and Hai prefectures — not approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat proposed opening trade with Song to choke off smugglers, bring home subjects trapped in Song territory, and scout Lian and Hai—the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 以劉仁傑不附李亶，擢益都路總管，仍以金帛賜之。

translations.literal: Because Liu Renjie had not joined Li Tan, he was promoted to zongguan of Yidu Circuit and granted gold and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Renjie, who had refused to follow Li Tan, was promoted to commander of Yidu circuit and rewarded with gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，授益都行中書省都督府所統州郡官金符十七、銀符十一。

translations.literal: On renxu day, seventeen gold tally tokens and eleven silver tally tokens were granted to officials of prefectures and counties under the Grand Governorate of the Yidu Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day seventeen gold tallies and eleven silver tallies were issued to prefectural and county officers under the Yidu branch secretariat's grand governorship.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔禁京畿畋獵。

translations.literal: On yichou day, an edict forbade hunting in the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day hunting in the capital region was banned.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，分東西兩川都元帥府為二，以帖的及劉整等為都元帥及左右副都元帥。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, the Eastern and Western Sichuan grand command headquarters were split in two; Tede and Liu Zheng and others were made grand commanders and left and right deputy grand commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the eastern and western Sichuan grand marshals' offices were divided in two; Tede, Liu Zheng, and others were named grand marshals and left and right deputies.

sentences.zh: 詔責高麗欺慢之罪。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Goryeo for disrespect.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Goryeo for arrogance and slights.

sentences.zh: 又詔賜高麗王禃歷。

translations.literal: Another edict granted King Wang Chon of Goryeo an official calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict presented King Wang Chon of Goryeo with the reign calendar.

sentences.zh: 以戰功賞渠州達魯花赤王章等金五十兩、銀一千五百五十兩。

translations.literal: For military merit, Wang Zhang, darughachi of Qu Prefecture, and others were rewarded fifty taels of gold and 1,550 taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhang, darughachi of Qu Prefecture, and others were rewarded for battle honors with fifty taels of gold and 1,550 taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 賞閬、蓬等路都元帥合州戰功銀五千兩。

translations.literal: Five thousand taels of silver were granted for military merit at He Prefecture under the grand commander of Lang and Peng circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand taels of silver were granted for feats at He Prefecture under the grand marshal of Lang and Peng circuits.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔鳳翔府屯田軍隸兵籍，仍屯田鳳翔。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, an edict placed Fengxiang Prefecture's garrison-farm troops under military registers while continuing to farm at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict enrolled Fengxiang's garrison-farming troops in the army rolls while keeping them on the land at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 放刁國器所簽平陽軍九百一十五人為民。

translations.literal: Nine hundred fifteen troops drafted by Diao Guoqi in Pingyang Army were released to civilian status.
translations.idiomatic: Nine hundred fifteen men levied by Diao Guoqi in Pingyang Army were discharged to civilian life.

sentences.zh: 閬、蓬、廣安、順慶、夔府等路都元帥欽察戍青居山，請益兵，詔陜西行省及鞏昌總帥汪惟正以兵益之。

translations.literal: Qincha, grand commander of Lang, Peng, Guang'an, Shunqing, Kuifu, and other circuits, garrisoned Qingju Mountain and requested reinforcements; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat and Wang Weizheng, commander of Gongchang, were ordered to augment him with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Qincha, grand marshal of Lang, Peng, Guang'an, Shunqing, Kuifu, and neighboring circuits, held Qingju Mountain and asked for more men; the Shaanxi branch secretariat and Wang Weizheng of Gongchang were ordered to send reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，楊大淵乞於利州大安軍以鹽易軍糧，從之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Yang Dayuan requested to exchange salt for army grain at Da'an Army in Li Prefecture — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Yang Dayuan asked to trade salt for rations at Da'an Army in Li Prefecture—the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕鞏昌總帥汪惟正將戍青居軍還，屯田利州。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Wang Weizheng, commander of Gongchang, was ordered to bring back the garrison at Qingju and farm at Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Wang Weizheng of Gongchang was told to withdraw the Qingju garrison and put the men to farming in Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，分中書左右部。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the Left and Right Sections of the Central Secretariat were divided.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Secretariat was split into left and right departments.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，敕宿州百戶王達等所擒宋王用、夏珍等八人赴京師。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, an order directed the eight Song captives Wang Yong, Xia Zhen, and others taken by Wang Da and other baihu of Suzhou to be sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an order sent to the capital the eight Song prisoners—Wang Yong, Xia Zhen, and the rest—seized by Wang Da and fellow centurions of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 命百家奴所將質子軍入侍。

translations.literal: The hostage-army led by Baijanu was ordered to enter court service.
translations.idiomatic: The hostage corps under Baijanu was ordered into palace service.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命不裏剌所統固安、平灤質子軍自益都徙還故地。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the hostage-armies of Gu'an and Pingluan under Bulila were ordered to move back from Yidu to their original lands.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Gu'an and Pingluan hostage troops under Bulila were ordered home from Yidu to their old stations.

sentences.zh: 詔益都府路官吏軍民為李亶脅從者，並赦其罪。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned all officials, soldiers, and civilians of Yidu Prefecture Circuit who had followed Li Tan under coercion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned every Yidu official, soldier, and commoner who had marched with Li Tan under duress.

sentences.zh: 敕萬戶嚴忠範修復宿州、蘄縣，萬戶忽都虎、懷都、何總管修完邳州城郭。

translations.literal: Wanhu Yan Zhongfan was ordered to restore Su Prefecture and Qi County; wanhu Huduhu, Huaidu, and Commander He were ordered to complete the walls of Pi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wanhu Yan Zhongfan was charged with rebuilding Su Prefecture and Qi County; wanhu Huduhu, Huaidu, and Commander He with finishing the walls of Pi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，太白犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, Venus transited the Hook and Flail asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the eleventh month Venus crossed the Hook and Flail.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕聖安寺作佛頂金輪會，長春宮設金箓周天醮。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, an order directed Shengan Temple to hold the Buddha-Crown Golden Wheel Assembly and Changchun Palace to set up the Golden Register Universal Heaven Ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Shengan Temple was ordered to hold the Buddha-Crown Golden Wheel rite and Changchun Palace to perform the Golden Register ritual for All under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，日有背氣重暈三珥。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the sun showed a counter-glow with a triple halo and three mock suns.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the sun showed a counter-glow, a heavy triple halo, and three attendant disks.

sentences.zh: 敕濟南人民為李亶裨校掠取財物者，詣都督撒吉思所訟之。

translations.literal: Jinan people whose goods had been plundered by Li Tan's officers were ordered to bring suits before Grand Governor Sagis.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan people robbed by Li Tan's lieutenants were told to bring their claims before Grand Governor Sagis.

sentences.zh: 真定民郝興仇殺馬忠，忠子榮受興銀，令興代其軍役。

translations.literal: The Zhending commoner Hao Xing killed Ma Zhong in revenge; Zhong's son Rong accepted silver from Xing and had Xing take his place in military service.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhending the commoner Hao Xing killed Ma Zhong to avenge a grudge; Zhong's son Rong took silver from Xing and let Xing stand in for his army duty.

sentences.zh: 中書省以榮納賂忘仇，無人子之道，杖之，沒其銀。

translations.literal: The Secretariat judged Rong for taking bribes and forgetting his feud — unworthy of a son — flogged him and confiscated the silver.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat ruled that Rong, bought off and forgetful of vengeance, had failed the duty of a son; he was flogged and the silver forfeited.

sentences.zh: 事聞，詔論如法。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict affirmed the judgment according to law.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, an edict upheld the sentence as lawful.

sentences.zh: 有司失出之罪，俾中書省議之。

translations.literal: The crime of the officials' leniency in sentencing was referred to the Secretariat for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The local officers' offense of undue leniency was left to the Secretariat to decide.

sentences.zh: 三叉沽竈戶經宋兵焚掠，免今年租賦。

translations.literal: Salt-pan households at Sanchagou, burned and plundered by Song troops, were exempted from this year's rent and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Salt-boiler households at Sanchagou, burned and looted by Song troops, were excused this year's rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 汰少府監工匠，存其良者千二百戶。

translations.literal: Artisans of the Palace Workshop Directorate were culled; the skilled among them, twelve hundred households, were retained.
translations.idiomatic: Craftsmen of the palace workshops were thinned out; the able twelve hundred households were kept.

sentences.zh: 遣官審理陜西重刑。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to review serious criminal cases in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners were sent to hear capital and other grave cases in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 敕河西民徙居應州，其不能自贍者百六十戶，給牛具及粟麥種，仍賜布，人二匹。

translations.literal: Hexi people migrating to Ying Prefecture: one hundred sixty households unable to support themselves were given oxen, tools, and millet and wheat seed; cloth was also granted, two bolts per person.
translations.idiomatic: Among Hexi people resettled in Ying Prefecture, one hundred sixty destitute households received oxen, tools, and millet and wheat seed; each person was also given two bolts of cloth.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔都元帥阿術分兵三千人同阿鮮不花、懷都兵馬，復立宿州、蘄縣、邳州。

translations.literal: On yisi day, an edict ordered Grand Commander Aju to divide out three thousand troops together with the forces of Axiambuhua and Huaidu to re-establish Su Prefecture, Qi County, and Pi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict told Grand Commander Aju to detach three thousand men, join the forces of Axiambuhua and Huaidu, and reestablish Su Prefecture, Qi County, and Pi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 有旨諭史天澤：「朕或乘怒欲有所誅殺，卿等宜遲留一二日，覆奏行之。

translations.literal: An order instructed Shi Tianze: "If I act in anger and wish to execute someone, you should delay one or two days and submit a memorial before carrying it out."
translations.idiomatic: Kublai instructed Shi Tianze: "When anger moves me to kill, hold the order a day or two and memorialise back before you act."

sentences.zh: 」丙午，詔特征人員，宜令乘傳。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, an edict for specially recruited personnel ordered that they travel by relay courier.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict on special recruitment ordered that appointees travel by official relay.

sentences.zh: 戊申，升撫州為隆興府，以昔剌斡脫為總管，割宣德之懷安、天成及威寧、高原隸焉。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Fu Prefecture was promoted to Longxing Prefecture, with Sirag'otu as zongguan; Huai'an and Tiancheng of Xuande and Weining and Gaoyuan were severed and placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Fu Prefecture was raised to Longxing Prefecture under Sirag'otu; Huai'an and Tiancheng of Xuande and Weining and Gaoyuan were cut away and attached to it.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，封皇子真金為燕王，守中書令。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiayin day, Prince Zhenjin was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and appointed to hold the Directorship of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the twelfth month an edict invested Prince Zhenjin as Prince of Yan and made him Director of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，敕諸王塔察兒等所部獵戶止收包銀，其絲稅輸之有司。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an order was issued to the hunting households under Prince Tachar and others to collect only tribute silver; their silk tax was to be remitted to the government offices.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Princes Tachar and his peers were told that their hunting households should collect only tribute silver and remit the silk tax to the proper offices.

sentences.zh: 立河南、山東統軍司，以塔剌渾火兒赤為河南路統軍使，盧升副之，東距亳州，西至均州，諸萬戶隸焉；

translations.literal: Army Control Commissions for Henan and Shandong were established; Tarqun Qočin was made Army Controller of the Henan Route with Lu Sheng as his deputy — east from Bozhou west to Jun Prefecture, with all wanhu placed under their command;
translations.idiomatic: The Henan and Shandong army control commissions were established, with Tarqun Qočin as Henan army controller and Lu Sheng as deputy; their jurisdiction ran from Bozhou in the east to Jun Prefecture in the west, and all wanhu therein were placed under them;

sentences.zh: 茶不花為山東路統軍使，武秀副之，西自宿州，東至寧海州，諸萬戶隸焉。

translations.literal: Chabuhua was made Army Controller of the Shandong Route with Wu Xiu as deputy — west from Suzhou east to Ninghai Prefecture, with all wanhu placed under them.
translations.idiomatic: Chabuhua was made Shandong army controller, with Wu Xiu as deputy; his command ran from Suzhou in the west to Ninghai Prefecture in the east, and all wanhu therein were placed under him.

sentences.zh: 罷各路急遞鋪。

translations.literal: The courier relay stations in all circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Courier relay stations in every circuit were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，立十路宣慰司，以真定路達魯花赤趙晉等為之。

translations.literal: On dingsi day ten circuit Pacification Commissions were established, with Zhao Jin, darughachi of the Zhending Route, and others appointed to them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day ten circuit pacification commissions were set up, with Zhao Jin, darughachi of Zhending, and others placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 己未，犯罪應死者五十三人，詔重加詳讞。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, fifty-three persons whose crimes warranted death were ordered to undergo renewed detailed review.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict ordered renewed careful review of fifty-three capital cases.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔給懷州新民耕牛二百，俾種水田。

translations.literal: On xinyou day an edict ordered two hundred plow oxen given to new settlers in Huai Prefecture to plant paddy fields.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the court granted two hundred plow oxen to new settlers in Huai Prefecture for planting paddy.

sentences.zh: 立諸路轉運司，以燕京路監榷官曹澤等為之使。

translations.literal: Transport Commissions were established in all circuits, with Cao Ze, Supervisory Control Officer of the Yanjing Route, and others made commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissions were established in every circuit, with Cao Ze of Yanjing's salt and tax office and others as commissioners.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，享太廟。

translations.literal: On guihai day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔：「各路總管兼萬戶者，止理民事，軍政勿預。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Circuit administrators who also hold wanhu rank shall handle only civil affairs and not intervene in military matters.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Circuit administrators who also hold wanhu rank shall govern only civil affairs and keep out of military matters.

sentences.zh: 其州縣官兼千戶、百戶者，仍其舊。

translations.literal: For prefecture and county officials who also hold qianhu or baihu rank, the previous arrangement remains.
translations.idiomatic: For prefecture and county officials who also hold qianhu or baihu rank, the old arrangement stood.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，復立息州城以安其民。

translations.literal: " On yichou day Xi Prefecture's walls were rebuilt to settle its people.
translations.idiomatic: " On yichou day Xi Prefecture's walls were rebuilt to settle the people.

sentences.zh: 召真定、順德等路宣慰使王磐乘傳赴京師。

translations.literal: Wang Pan, Pacification Commissioner of the Zhending, Shunde, and other circuits, was summoned by relay post to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Pan, pacification commissioner of Zhending, Shunde, and other circuits, was summoned by relay post to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，申嚴屠殺牛馬之禁。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the prohibition against slaughtering cattle and horses was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the ban on slaughtering cattle and horses was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔：「諸路管民總管子弟，有分管州、府、司、縣及鷹坊、人匠諸色事務者，罷之。

translations.literal: On jisi day an edict stated: "Among the sons of circuit civilian administrators, those assigned to manage prefectures, fu, commissions, counties, and falcon offices, artisan offices, and various other posts shall be removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict ordered: "Among the sons of circuit civilian administrators, those put in charge of prefectures, fu, commissions, counties, falcon offices, artisan offices, and other posts were to be removed.

sentences.zh: 」壬申，遣使收輯諸路軍民官海青牌及驛券。

translations.literal: " On renshen day envoys were dispatched to collect gyrfalcon passes and relay vouchers held by military and civilian officials in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: " On renshen day envoys were sent to collect gyrfalcon passes and relay vouchers from military and civilian officials in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔：「諸路管民官理民事，管軍官掌兵戎，各有所司，不相統攝。

translations.literal: On wuyin day an edict stated: "In all circuits, civilian administrators govern civil affairs and military officers command troops — each has his charge, and neither shall supervise the other.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict declared: "In every circuit civilian administrators govern civil affairs and military officers command troops — each has his charge, and neither shall supervise the other.

sentences.zh: 」作佛事於昊天寺七晝夜，賜銀萬五千兩。

translations.literal: " Buddhist rites were performed at Haotian Temple for seven days and nights, and fifteen thousand taels of silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Buddhist rites were performed at Haotian Temple for seven days and nights, and fifteen thousand taels of silver were granted.

sentences.zh: 割北京、興州隸開平府。

translations.literal: Beijing and Xing Prefecture were detached and placed under Kaiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Beijing and Xing Prefecture districts were transferred to Kaiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 建行宮於隆興路。

translations.literal: A traveling palace was built at Longxing Route.
translations.idiomatic: A temporary palace was erected on the Longxing circuit.

sentences.zh: 升太原臨泉縣為臨州；

translations.literal: Linquan County in Taiyuan was promoted to Lin Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Linquan County in Taiyuan was elevated to Lin Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 降寧陵為下縣，仍隸歸德。

translations.literal: Ningling was reduced to a lower-rank county and remained under Guide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ningling was demoted to a lower-rank county and left under Guide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, bolts, and silk according to the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: Princes received gold, silver, bolts, and silk as in the annual custom.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶一百四十七萬六千一百四十六，斷死罪六十六人。

translations.literal: That year throughout the empire there were 1,476,146 households; sixty-six persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year the empire registered 1,476,146 households, and sixty-six persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙酉，禁蒙古軍馬擾民。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on yiyou day, Mongol troops and horses disturbing the people were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on yiyou day of the first month, Mongol troops and horses molesting civilians were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 宋賈似道遣楊琳賫空名告身及蠟書、金幣，誘大獲山楊大淵南歸，大淵部將執琳，詔誅之。

translations.literal: Song's Jia Sidao sent Yang Lin bearing blank commission appointments, wax-sealed letters, and gold and gifts to entice Yang Dayuan of Daguo Mountain to return south; Dayuan's subordinate officers seized Lin, and an edict ordered his execution.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao of the Song sent Yang Lin with blank commissions, sealed letters, and gold to lure Yang Dayuan of Daguo Mountain back to the Song; Dayuan's officers seized him, and the court ordered his execution.

sentences.zh: 以宋忽兒、滅裏及沙只回回鷹坊等兵戍商州、藍田諸隘。

translations.literal: Song Qočin, Mie'er, and troops of the Shazhi Muslim Falcon Office and others were stationed to guard the passes at Shang Prefecture, Lantian, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qočin, Mie'er, and forces of the Shazhi Muslim Falcon Office were garrisoned at the passes of Shang Prefecture, Lantian, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 軍民官各從統軍司及宣慰司選舉。

translations.literal: Military and civilian officials were each to be selected by the Army Control Commissions and Pacification Commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Military and civilian officials were henceforth chosen by the army control commissions and pacification commissions.

sentences.zh: 嶽天輔乞復立息州，不允。

translations.literal: Yue Tianfu requested that Xi Prefecture be rebuilt; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Tianfu asked that Xi Prefecture be restored; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以姚樞為中書左丞。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Yao Shu was made Left Associate of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Yao Shu was appointed Left Associate of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 改諸路監榷課稅所為轉運司。

translations.literal: The supervisory control and tax offices in all circuits were converted into Transport Commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory salt-and-tax offices in every circuit were reorganized as transport commissions.

sentences.zh: 甲午，給公主拜忽符印，其所屬設達魯花赤。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Princess Baihu was granted tally seals, and a darughachi was established for her domain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Princess Baihu received tally seals, and a darughachi was appointed over her household.

sentences.zh: 給鈔賑益都路貧民之無牛者。

translations.literal: Paper notes were granted to relieve the poor in Yidu Route who lacked oxen.
translations.idiomatic: Paper notes were issued to help Yidu's poor who had no oxen.

sentences.zh: 立十路奧魯總管。

translations.literal: Ordus superintendents were established in ten circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Ten circuit ordu superintendents were established.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，益都路行省大都督撒吉思上李亶所傷漣水軍民及陷宋蒙古、女直、探馬赤軍數，男女凡七千九百二十二人。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Sagis, Grand Governor of the Yidu Branch Secretariat, reported the count of Lianshui military and civilian casualties caused by Li Tan and Mongol, Jurchen, and tamaci troops lost to the Song — men and women together totaling 7,922.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Sagis, grand governor of the Yidu branch secretariat, reported that Li Tan's revolt had cost Lianshui 7,922 military and civilian lives, men and women together, and that many Mongol, Jurchen, and tamaci troops had been lost to the Song.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，領部阿合馬請興河南等處鐵冶及設東平等路巡禁私鹽軍，從之。

translations.literal: On guimao day Ahmad, controller of the secretariat staff, requested ironworks be opened in Henan and elsewhere and patrol forces established in Dongping and other routes to ban private salt; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Ahmad, head of the secretariat staff, asked to open ironworks in Henan and elsewhere and establish patrol forces in Dongping and other routes against private salt; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 召商挺、趙良弼赴闕。

translations.literal: Shang Ting and Zhao Liangbi were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Ting and Zhao Liangbi were summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，敕李平陽以所部西川出征軍士戍青居山，其各翼軍在青居山者悉還成都。
