translations.literal: On yisi day Li Pingyang was ordered to garrison Qingju Mountain with the Sichuan expeditionary troops under his command; all wing units then at Qingju Mountain were entirely returned to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Li Pingyang was ordered to hold Qingju Mountain with his Sichuan expeditionary troops, while every wing unit then stationed there was sent back to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 詔陜西行省塔剌海等收恤離散軍戶。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered, with Tarqai and others, to gather and care for dispersed military households.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi branch secretariat, Tarqai, and others were ordered to gather and support dispersed military households.

sentences.zh: 詔：「以諸路漢軍奧魯毋隸各萬戶管領，其科征差稅，山東、河南隸統軍司，東西兩川隸征東元帥府，陜西隸行戶部。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The ordus of Han troops in all circuits shall no longer be administered by individual wanhu; their levies and taxes in Shandong and Henan shall fall under the Army Control Commissions, in the Eastern and Western Sichuan routes under the Eastern Expedition Grand Marshal's headquarters, and in Shaanxi under the branch Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Han troop ordus in every circuit would no longer be run by individual wanhu; their levies in Shandong and Henan would fall to the army control commissions, in eastern and western Sichuan to the Eastern Expedition headquarters, and in Shaanxi to the branch Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 凡奧魯官內有各萬戶弟、男及私人，皆罷之。

translations.literal: All younger brothers, sons, and private associates of wanhu within ordu offices shall be removed.
translations.idiomatic: All younger brothers, sons, and private associates of wanhu serving in ordu offices were to be removed.

sentences.zh: 」敕總帥汪忠臣、都元帥帖的及劉整等益兵付都元帥欽察，戍青居山，仍以解州鹽課給軍糧。

translations.literal: " Grand Commander Wang Zhongchen, Grand Marshal Tedi, Liu Zheng, and others were ordered to reinforce troops and hand them to Grand Marshal Qincha to garrison Qingju Mountain, with grain supplied from the salt levy of Jie Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " Grand Commander Wang Zhongchen, Grand Marshal Tedi, Liu Zheng, and others were ordered to send reinforcements to Grand Marshal Qincha at Qingju Mountain, with grain paid from the salt levy of Jie Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔諸翼萬戶簡精兵四千充武衛軍。

translations.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered each wing wanhu to select four thousand picked troops to serve in the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day each wing wanhu was ordered to select four thousand picked men for the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 罷古北口新置驛。

translations.literal: The newly established relay station at Gubeikou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The newly opened relay station at Gubeikou was disbanded.

sentences.zh: 增萬戶府監戰一員、參議一員。

translations.literal: One battle supervisor and one counsellor were added to each wanhu headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Each wanhu headquarters gained one battle supervisor and one counsellor.

sentences.zh: 以馬合麻所俘濟南老僧口之民文面為奴者，付元籍為民。

translations.literal: Captives from Laosengkou in Jinan whom Mahema had taken and whose faces had been tattooed as slaves were restored to their original household registers as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: People from Laosengkou in Jinan whom Mahema had captured and marked with facial tattoos as slaves were returned to their original registers as free commoners.

sentences.zh: 汪忠臣、史權系宋諜者六人至京師，有旨釋之。

translations.literal: Wang Zhongchen and Shi Quan bound six Song spies and brought them to the capital; an imperial order released them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhongchen and Shi Quan brought six captured Song spies to the capital, and the Emperor ordered them released.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，申禁民家兵器及蒙古軍擾民者。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the prohibitions against weapons in private homes and against Mongol troops disturbing the people were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the bans on civilian weapons and on Mongol troops molesting the people were reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 陵州達魯花赤蒙哥戰死濟南，以其子忙兀帶襲職。

translations.literal: Möngke, darughachi of Ling Prefecture, was killed in battle at Jinan; his son Mangudai succeeded to the post.
translations.idiomatic: Möngke, darughachi of Ling Prefecture, fell at Jinan; his son Mangudai inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 召雲頂山侍郎張威赴闕。

translations.literal: Zhang Wei, Vice Director of Yunding Mountain, was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wei, vice director of Yunding Mountain, was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔，命河東宣慰司市馬百二十九匹，賜諸王八剌軍士之無馬者。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the renzi new moon, the Hedong Pacification Commission was ordered to purchase one hundred twenty-nine horses to grant to soldiers under Prince Baraq who lacked mounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the second month the Hedong pacification commission was told to buy one hundred twenty-nine horses for soldiers under Prince Baraq who had no mounts.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔諸路官員子弟入質。

translations.literal: On jiayin day an edict ordered sons of officials in all circuits to enter court as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day officials throughout the empire were ordered to send their sons to court as hostages.

sentences.zh: 以高麗不答詔書，詰其使者。

translations.literal: Because Goryeo had not answered the imperial edict, its envoy was interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: Because Goryeo failed to answer the imperial edict, its envoy was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 以民杜了翁先朝舊功，復其家。

translations.literal: Because the commoner Du Liaoweng had rendered service in a former reign, his household was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Because Du Liaoweng had served in a former reign, his family's standing was restored.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賞萬戶怯來所部將士討李亶有功者銀二千七百五十兩。

translations.literal: On gengshen day two thousand seven hundred fifty taels of silver were awarded to officers and soldiers under Wanhu Kelai who had merit in suppressing Li Tan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Kelai's wanhu troops who had merit against Li Tan were rewarded with two thousand seven hundred fifty taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 甲子，車駕幸開平。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the imperial carriage went to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court traveled to Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 以王德素充國信使，劉公諒副之，使於宋，致書宋主，詰其稽留郝經之故。

translations.literal: Wang Desu was made Chief Envoy and Liu Gongliang Deputy Envoy and sent to the Song with a letter to the Song ruler pressing the reason for detaining Hao Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Desu was made chief envoy and Liu Gongliang deputy envoy and sent to the Song with a letter asking why Hao Jing had been detained.

sentences.zh: 詔：「諸路置局造軍器，私造者處死；

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Each circuit shall establish offices for making military equipment; private manufacture is punishable by death;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Every circuit shall set up offices for making military equipment; private manufacture is punishable by death;

sentences.zh: 民間所有，不輸官者，與私造同。」

translations.literal: Weapons held by the populace that are not surrendered to the government shall be treated the same as private manufacture."
translations.idiomatic: Weapons held by civilians that were not surrendered to the government would be treated like private manufacture."

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，沂州胡節使、範同知陷於宋，命存恤其家。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuzi day, Hu the jiedushi and Fan the vice commissioner of Yizhou were captured by the Song; their families were ordered to be cared for.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi day, Hu the military commissioner and Fan the vice commissioner of Yizhou fell to the Song; the court ordered their families provided for.

sentences.zh: 或言其嘗為宋兵向導，乃分其妻孥資產，賜有功將士。

translations.literal: Some said they had once guided Song troops; their wives, children, and property were therefore divided and granted to meritorious officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When reports surfaced that they had once guided Song troops, their wives, children, and property were divided up and given to meritorious officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，敕撒吉思招集益都逃民。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Sagis was ordered to gather the fugitive populace of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Sagis was ordered to bring back Yidu's fugitive population.

sentences.zh: 命董文炳以所獲宋諜及俘八十一人赴隆興府。

translations.literal: Dong Wenbing was ordered to bring the captured Song spies and eighty-one prisoners to Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Wenbing was ordered to escort the Song spies he had captured and eighty-one prisoners to Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 聽諸路獵戶及捕盜巡鹽者執弓矢。

translations.literal: Hunting households and salt patrol and bandit-capture personnel in all circuits were permitted to carry bow and arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting households and patrolmen hunting bandits and illicit salt in every circuit were allowed to bear bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣紥馬剌丁和糴東京。

translations.literal: On renchen day Jamaluddin was dispatched to purchase grain at fixed prices in Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Jamaluddin was sent to buy grain by compulsory purchase in the Eastern Capital district.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諸路包銀以鈔輸納，其絲料入本色，非產絲之地，亦聽以鈔輸入。

translations.literal: On jihai day tribute silver in all circuits was to be paid in paper notes; silk levies were to be paid in kind; in places that did not produce silk, payment in notes was also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day tribute silver in every circuit was to be paid in paper notes; silk levies were due in kind, but non-silk-producing regions might pay in notes instead.

sentences.zh: 凡當差戶包銀鈔四兩，每十戶輸絲十四斤，漏籍老幼鈔三兩、絲一斤。

translations.literal: For liable households tribute silver was four taels in notes; for every ten households fourteen jin of silk; for unregistered elderly and children three taels in notes and one jin of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Liable households paid four taels of notes in tribute silver; every ten households contributed fourteen jin of silk; unregistered elderly and children owed three taels in notes and one jin of silk.

sentences.zh: 庚子，亦黑叠兒丁請修瓊華島，不從。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Yihei Dierding requested repairs to Qionghua Isle; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Yihei Dierding asked to repair Qionghua Isle; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，關東蒙古、漢軍官未經訓敕者，令各乘傳赴開平。

translations.literal: On renyin day Mongol and Han officers east of the passes who had not yet received imperial instructions were each ordered to ride relay post to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Mongol and Han officers in the eastern region who had not yet received imperial briefing were ordered to Kaiping by relay post.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，初建太廟。

translations.literal: On guimao day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was first built.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day construction of the Imperial Ancestral Temple began for the first time.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賜叠怯那延等銀七千九十兩。

translations.literal: On yisi day Dieqie Noyan and others were granted seven thousand ninety taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Dieqie Noyan and others received seven thousand ninety taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 命北京元帥阿海發漢軍二千人赴開平。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Ahai of Beijing was ordered to send two thousand Han troops to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing commander Ahai was ordered to march two thousand Han troops to Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 己酉，高麗國王王禃遣其臣朱英亮入貢，上表謝恩。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, sent his minister Zhu Yingliang to offer tribute and submit a memorial thanking the court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent the minister Zhu Yingliang with tribute and a memorial of thanks.

sentences.zh: 復立宿州。

translations.literal: Suzhou was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌朔，以漏籍戶一萬一千八百、附籍戶四千三百於各處起冶，歲課鐵四百八十萬七千斤。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on the gengxu new moon, 11,800 unregistered households and 4,300 attached households were put to ironworks in various places, with an annual levy of 4,807,000 jin of iron.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the fourth summer month, 11,800 unregistered and 4,300 attached households were assigned to ironworks throughout the realm, producing an annual levy of 4,807,000 jin of iron.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，選益都兵千人充武衛軍。

translations.literal: On guichou day one thousand troops from Yidu were selected to serve in the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day one thousand Yidu troops were drafted into the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，償河西阿沙賑贍所部貧民銀三千七百兩。

translations.literal: On jiayin day three thousand seven hundred taels of silver were repaid to Asha of Hexi for relief he had given his impoverished followers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the court reimbursed Asha of Hexi three thousand seven hundred taels of silver he had spent feeding his poor followers.

sentences.zh: 己未，以完顏端田宅賜益都千戶傅國忠。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the fields and dwelling of Wanyan Duan were granted to Fu Guozhong, qianhu of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the fields and house of Wanyan Duan were granted to Yidu qianhu Fu Guozhong.

sentences.zh: 國忠父天祐為端所殺，故命以其田宅賜之。

translations.literal: Guozhong's father Tianyou had been killed by Duan; he was therefore ordered granted Duan's fields and dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: Because Duan had killed Guozhong's father Tianyou, the court granted him Duan's fields and dwelling.

sentences.zh: 宣德至開平置驛。

translations.literal: Relay stations were placed from Xuande to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: Relay posts were established from Xuande to Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 罷開元路宣慰司。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commission of the Kaiyuan Route was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaiyuan pacification commission was disbanded.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，西京武州隕霜殺稼。

translations.literal: On bingyin day frost fell at Wuzhou in the Western Capital region and destroyed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day a killing frost at Wuzhou in the Western Capital region destroyed the crops.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，召竇默、許衡乘驛赴開平。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Dou Mo and Xu Heng were summoned by relay post to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Dou Mo and Xu Heng were summoned to Kaiping by relay post.

sentences.zh: 諸王阿只吉所部貧民遠徙者，賜以馬牛車幣。

translations.literal: Impoverished people under Prince Ajigi who had migrated far were granted horses, oxen, carts, and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Poor followers of Prince Ajigi who had migrated far received horses, oxen, carts, and cloth.

sentences.zh: 以東平為軍行蹂踐，賑給之。

translations.literal: Because Dongping had been trampled by passing armies, relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Because passing armies had trampled Dongping, the court granted relief.

sentences.zh: 改滄清深鹽提領所為轉運司。

translations.literal: The salt supervisor's office of Cang, Qing, and Shen was converted into a Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Cang-Qing-Shen salt office was reorganized as a transport commission.

sentences.zh: 王鶚請延訪太祖事跡付史館。

translations.literal: Wang E requested that Taizu's deeds be collected by extended inquiry and delivered to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E asked that Taizu's deeds be gathered by inquiry and sent to the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，詔北京運米五千石赴開平，其車牛之費並從官給。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guiwei day, an edict ordered five thousand shi of grain transported from Beijing to Kaiping, with cart and ox costs all paid from official funds.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei day, the court ordered five thousand shi of grain shipped from Beijing to Kaiping, with cart and ox costs paid from official funds.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，初立樞密院，以皇子燕王守中書令，兼判樞密院事。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the Bureau of Military Affairs was first established; the Prince of Yan, holding the Directorship of the Central Secretariat, was concurrently appointed to decide Bureau of Military Affairs affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Bureau of Military Affairs was established for the first time; the Prince of Yan, who held the Central Secretariat directorship, was made concurrent head of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊子，升開平府為上都，其達魯花赤兀良吉為上都路達魯花赤，總管董銓為上都路總管兼開平府尹。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Kaiping Prefecture was elevated to Shangdu; its darughachi Urungqi was made darughachi of the Shangdu Route, and Administrator Dong Quan was made Administrator of the Shangdu Route concurrent Prefect of Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Kaiping was elevated to Shangdu; Urungqi was made darughachi of Shangdu Route, and Dong Quan was made route administrator and concurrent Kaiping prefect.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔立燕京平準庫，以均平物價，通利鈔法。

translations.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered a Stabilization Treasury established at Yanjing to equalize prices and promote the paper-note system.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court established a Stabilization Treasury at Yanjing to stabilize prices and promote paper currency.

sentences.zh: 乙未，敕商州民就戍本州，毋禁弓矢。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the people of Shang Prefecture were ordered to garrison their own prefecture and were not forbidden bow and arrow.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Shang Prefecture's people were ordered to garrison locally, and they were not forbidden to carry bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 丙申，立上都馬、步驛。

translations.literal: On bingshen day horse and foot relay stations were established at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day horse and foot relay stations were set up at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以元帥楊大淵、張大悅復神山有功，降詔獎諭。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Grand Marshals Yang Dayuan and Zhang Dayue, who had merit in recovering Shen Mountain, received an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Yang Dayuan and Zhang Dayue, who had merit recovering Shen Mountain, received an edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以禮部尚書馬月合乃兼領潁州、光化互市，及領已括戶三千，興煽鐵冶，歲輸鐵一百三萬七千斤，就鑄農器二十萬事，易粟四萬石輸官，河南隨處城邑市鐵之家，令仍舊鼓鑄。

translations.literal: Ma Yuehenai, Minister of Rites, was concurrently put in charge of the Ying and Guanghua border markets and of three thousand registered households, to operate ironworks yielding 1,037,000 jin of iron annually, cast two hundred thousand farm implements on the spot, exchange them for forty thousand shi of grain for delivery to the government, and the iron merchants in towns throughout Henan were ordered to continue smelting as before.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Ma Yuehenai was also placed over the Ying and Guanghua border markets and three thousand registered households to run ironworks yielding 1,037,000 jin of iron a year, cast two hundred thousand farm tools on site, trade them for forty thousand shi of grain for the state, while iron merchants in Henan towns were told to keep smelting as before.

sentences.zh: 庚子，河南路總管劉克興矯制括戶，罷其職，籍家資之半。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Liu Kexing, Administrator of the Henan Route, registered households by forged decree; he was dismissed from office and half his property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Liu Kexing, administrator of Henan, conducted a household registration on forged authority; he was dismissed and half his property seized.

sentences.zh: 升上都路望雲縣為雲州，松山縣為松州。

translations.literal: Wangyun County in the Shangdu Route was promoted to Yun Prefecture, and Songshan County to Song Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wangyun County in Shangdu Route was elevated to Yun Prefecture and Songshan County to Song Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賞前討渾都海戰功，撒裏都、闊闊出等鈔二千一百七十四錠、幣帛一千四百二十匹。

translations.literal: For merit in the earlier campaign against Qunduqai, Saridu, Köke Böke, and others were awarded 2,174 ingots of notes and 1,420 bolts of cloth and silk.
translations.idiomatic: For service against Qunduqai, Saridu, Köke Böke, and others received 2,174 ingots of notes and 1,420 bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，河間、益都、燕京、真定、東平諸路蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renzi day, locusts afflicted the Hejian, Yidu, Yanjing, Zhending, and Dongping circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi day, locusts struck Hejian, Yidu, Yanjing, Zhending, and Dongping.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以管民官兼統懷孟等軍俺撒戰歿汴梁，命其子忙兀帶為萬戶，佩金符。

translations.literal: On yimao day, because Ansa, civil administration officer concurrently commanding the Huaimeng and other armies, died in battle at Bianliang, his son Mangudai was appointed wanhu and granted a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Ansa, who had commanded the Huaimeng armies while serving as a civil administration officer, fell at Bianliang; his son Mangudai was made wanhu and given a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜線真田戶六百。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, six hundred field households were granted to Xianzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Xianzhen received six hundred field households.

sentences.zh: 己未，賜高麗國王王禃羊五百。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, five hundred sheep were granted to King Wang Chon of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day King Wang Chon of Goryeo was granted five hundred sheep.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賜拜忽公主所部鈔千錠。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, one thousand ingots of notes were granted to Princess Baihu's domain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day one thousand ingots of notes were granted to the households under Princess Baihu.

sentences.zh: 立上都惠民藥局。

translations.literal: A Public Benevolence Medicine Bureau was established at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: A public-benefit pharmacy bureau was opened at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 建帝堯廟於平陽，仍賜田十五頃。

translations.literal: A temple to Emperor Yao was built at Pingyang, and fifteen qing of fields were granted besides.
translations.idiomatic: A temple to Emperor Yao was built at Pingyang, with fifteen qing of fields granted to support it.

sentences.zh: 以線真為中書右丞相，塔察兒為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: Xianzhen was made Right Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat and Tachar Left Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhen was appointed Right Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat and Tachar Left Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，詔諸投下毋擅勾攝燕京路州縣官吏。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guiwei day, an edict ordered appanage princes not to summon on their own authority officials of the Yanjing circuit prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei day, an edict forbade appanage princes to detain Yanjing circuit prefectural and county officials on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，禁野狐嶺行營民，毋入南、北口縱畜牧，損踐桑稼。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, people at the field camp at Wild Fox Ridge were forbidden to enter the Southern or Northern passes to graze livestock and damage mulberry crops and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day people at the Wild Fox Ridge field camp were forbidden to drive livestock through the Southern or Northern passes and trample mulberry fields and grain.

sentences.zh: 給公主拜忽銀五萬兩，合剌合納銀千兩。

translations.literal: Princess Baihu was given fifty thousand taels of silver, and Qaraqana one thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Baihu received fifty thousand taels of silver, and Qaraqana one thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以故東平權萬戶呂義死王事，賜謚貞節。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, because the late acting wanhu of Dongping, Lü Yi, died in the service of the state, he was posthumously given the honorific title Zhenjie.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Lü Yi, the late acting wanhu of Dongping who had died in state service, was posthumously honored with the title Zhenjie.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔弛河南沿邊軍器之禁。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, an edict relaxed the prohibition on weapons along Henan's border.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict eased the ban on weapons along the Henan frontier.

sentences.zh: 升燕京屬縣安次為東安州，固安為固安州。

translations.literal: Anci County in Yanjing Circuit was promoted to Dong'an Prefecture, and Gu'an to Gu'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Anci County in Yanjing circuit was elevated to Dong'an Prefecture, and Gu'an to Gu'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河南統軍司言：「屯田民為保甲丁壯射生軍，凡三千四百人，分戍沿邊州郡，乞蠲他徭。

translations.literal: The Henan Army Control Commission reported: "The garrison-farming populace serving as local-defense archer troops and scout soldiers totaled three thousand four hundred; they were divided to garrison border prefectures and counties, and they request exemption from other corvée obligations.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan army control commission reported that three thousand four hundred garrison-farming men serving as local-defense archers and scouts had been posted to border prefectures and counties, and asked that their other corvée duties be remitted.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔賜諸王爪都牛馬價銀六萬三千一百兩。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an edict granted Prince Jadu sixty-three thousand one hundred taels of silver as payment for oxen and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict granted Prince Jadu sixty-three thousand one hundred taels of silver to cover ox and horse costs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔禁益都路探馬赤擾民。

translations.literal: On renyin day, an edict forbade tamaci in the Yidu Route from molesting the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict forbade tamaci in Yidu circuit from harassing civilians.

sentences.zh: 以成都經略司隸西川行院。

translations.literal: The Chengdu Pacification Commission was placed under the Western Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengdu pacification commission was subordinated to the Western Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 禁蒙古、漢軍諸人煎、販私鹽。

translations.literal: Mongols, Han troops, and others were forbidden to boil and sell private salt.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols, Han soldiers, and others were forbidden to produce or traffic in illicit salt.

sentences.zh: 詔山東經略司徙膠、萊、莒、密之民及竈戶居內地。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Shandong Pacification Commission to move the people of Jiao, Lai, Ju, and Mi and the salt households inland.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the Shandong pacification commission to relocate the people of Jiao, Lai, Ju, and Mi and the salt households inland.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣以妨煮鹽為言，遂令統軍司完復邊戍，居民竈戶毋徙。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat ministers said this would obstruct salt boiling; thereupon the Army Control Commission was ordered to restore the border garrisons, and resident and salt households were not to be moved.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat ministers warned that the move would disrupt salt production, so the army control commission was ordered to restore the border garrisons and leave resident and salt households in place.

sentences.zh: 詔阿術戒蒙古軍，不得以民田為牧地。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Aju to warn the Mongol army not to use civilian fields as pasture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told Aju to warn Mongol troops not to turn civilian farmland into pasture.

sentences.zh: 燕京、河間、開平、隆興四路屬縣雨雹害稼。

translations.literal: Attached counties in the Yanjing, Hejian, Kaiping, and Longxing circuits were harmed by hail that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Attached counties in Yanjing, Hejian, Kaiping, and Longxing were hit by hail that destroyed the crops.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申朔，詔霍木海總管諸路驛，佩金符。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wushen new moon, an edict ordered Huomuhai to supervise relay stations in all circuits and granted him a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the eighth month an edict put Huomuhai in charge of relay stations in every circuit and granted him a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，置元帥府於大理。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, a Marshal's Headquarters was established at Dali.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day a marshal's headquarters was established at Dali.

sentences.zh: 詔東平、大名、河南宣慰司市馬千五百五十匹，給阿術等軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Dongping, Daming, and Henan Pacification Commissions to purchase one thousand five hundred fifty horses for the armies of Aju and others.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Dongping, Daming, and Henan pacification commissions to buy one thousand five hundred fifty horses for Aju's army and others.

sentences.zh: 升宣德州為宣德府，隸上都。

translations.literal: Xuan Prefecture was promoted to Xuande Prefecture and placed under Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan Prefecture was elevated to Xuande Prefecture and placed under Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 以淄、萊、登三州為總管府，治淄州。

translations.literal: Zi, Lai, and Deng prefectures were combined into a Route General Command, with its seat at Zi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zi, Lai, and Deng were combined into a route general command headquartered at Zi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 命昔撒昔總制鬼國、大理兩路。

translations.literal: Sisaxi was ordered to take overall control of the Ghost Country and Dali routes.
translations.idiomatic: Sisaxi was ordered to take overall control of the Ghost Country and Dali routes.

sentences.zh: 兵部郎中劉芳前使大理，至吐蕃遇害，命恤其家。

translations.literal: Liu Fang, Director in the Ministry of Rites, who had earlier been envoy to Dali, was killed by bandits when he reached Tibet; an edict ordered his family comforted.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fang of the Ministry of Rites, who had earlier served as envoy to Dali, was killed by bandits in Tibet; the court ordered his family compensated.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命中書省給北京、西京轉運司車牛價鈔。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the Central Secretariat was ordered to supply paper money for cart and ox costs to the Beijing and Western Capital transport commissions.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Central Secretariat was told to provide notes for cart and ox costs to the Beijing and Western Capital transport commissions.

sentences.zh: 彰德路及洺、磁二州旱，免彰德今歲田租之半，洺、磁十之六。

translations.literal: Zhangde Circuit and Ming and Ci prefectures suffered drought; half of this year's field rent in Zhangde was remitted, and six-tenths in Ming and Ci.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde circuit and Ming and Ci prefectures suffered drought; half of Zhangde's field rent for the year was remitted, and six-tenths in Ming and Ci.

sentences.zh: 冀州蒙古百戶阿昔等犯鹽禁，沒入馬百二十餘匹，以給軍士之無馬者。

translations.literal: Axi and others, Mongol centurions of Ji Prefecture, violated the salt prohibition; more than one hundred twenty horses were confiscated and given to soldiers without mounts.
translations.idiomatic: Axi and other Mongol centurions of Ji Prefecture broke the salt ban; more than one hundred twenty of their horses were seized and given to soldiers who lacked mounts.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命成都路運米萬石餉潼川。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Chengdu Circuit was ordered to transport ten thousand shi of grain to provision Tongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Chengdu circuit was ordered to ship ten thousand shi of grain to Tongchuan.

sentences.zh: 給鈔付劉整市牛屯田。

translations.literal: Paper money was issued to Liu Zheng to purchase oxen for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Notes were issued to Liu Zheng to buy oxen for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 分劉元禮等軍戍潼川，命按敦將之。

translations.literal: Liu Yuanli's army and others were divided to garrison Tongchuan, and Andun was ordered to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Forces under Liu Yuanli and others were posted to garrison Tongchuan under Andun's command.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔以成都路綿州隸潼川。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, an edict ordered Mian Prefecture in Chengdu Circuit placed under Tongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict placed Mian Prefecture in Chengdu circuit under Tongchuan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以阿脫、商挺行樞密院於成都，凡成都、順慶、潼川都元帥府並聽節制。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Atu and Shang Ting were placed in charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs at Chengdu; the grand marshal headquarters of Chengdu, Shunqing, and Tongchuan were all placed under their control.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Atu and Shang Ting were put in charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs at Chengdu, with the Chengdu, Shunqing, and Tongchuan grand marshal headquarters all under their command.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以史天倪前為武仙所殺，以武仙第賜其子楫。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, because Shi Tianni had earlier been killed by Wu Xian, Wu Xian's residence was granted to his son Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, because Shi Tianni had earlier been killed by Wu Xian, Wu Xian's residence was granted to Tianni's son Ji.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，敕京兆路給賜劉整第一區、田二十頃。

translations.literal: On guihai day, an edict ordered Jingzhao Circuit to grant Liu Zheng one residence and twenty qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict ordered Jingzhao circuit to grant Liu Zheng one residence and twenty qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 以夢八剌所部貧乏，賜銀七千五百兩給之。

translations.literal: Because the people under Manggubala were impoverished, seven thousand five hundred taels of silver were granted to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Because Manggubala's followers were impoverished, seven thousand five hundred taels of silver were granted for their relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以西涼經兵，居民困弊，給鈔賑之，仍免租賦三年。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, because the Western Liang region had suffered warfare and the people were exhausted, paper money was issued for relief, and rents and levies were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because warfare had worn down Western Liang and its people, notes were issued for relief and rents and levies were waived for three years.

sentences.zh: 敕諸臣傳旨，有疑者須覆奏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that when ministers transmitted imperial instructions, any point of doubt had to be reported back for confirmation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required ministers transmitting imperial instructions to report back for confirmation whenever a point was doubtful.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以諸王只必帖木兒部民困乏，賜銀二萬兩給之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, because the people under Prince Jibtemür were destitute, twenty thousand taels of silver were granted to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because Prince Jibtemür's followers were destitute, twenty thousand taels of silver were granted for their relief.

sentences.zh: 壬申，復置急遞鋪。

translations.literal: On renshen day, express relay stations were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day express relay stations were restored.

sentences.zh: 濱、棣二州蝗，真定路旱。

translations.literal: Bin and Di prefectures suffered locusts; Zhending Circuit suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck Bin and Di prefectures, and Zhending circuit suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 詔西涼流民復業者，復其家三年。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Western Liang refugees who returned to their occupations should have their households exempted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Western Liang refugees who returned to their occupations should have their households exempted from levies for three years.

sentences.zh: 車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage arrived from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，河南、大名兩道宣慰司所獲宋諜王立、張達、刁俊等十八人，遇赦釋免，給衣服遣還。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renwu day, eighteen Song spies — Wang Li, Zhang Da, Diao Jun, and others — captured by the Henan and Daming Pacification Commissions were released under the general amnesty, given clothing, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu day, eighteen Song spies captured by the Henan and Daming pacification commissions — Wang Li, Zhang Da, Diao Jun, and others — were freed under the general amnesty, clothed, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立漕運河渠司。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the Grain Transport River and Canal Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the grain transport river-and-canal office was established.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賜諸王阿只吉所部種食、牛具。

translations.literal: On jichou day, seed grain and ox implements were granted to the people under Prince Ajigi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day seed grain and ox implements were granted to Prince Ajigi's followers.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，諭高麗、上京等處毋重科斂民。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Goryeo, Shangjing, and other places were instructed not to impose heavy levies on the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Goryeo, Shangjing, and other districts were told not to impose heavy levies on the people.

sentences.zh: 招諭濟南、濱棣流民。

translations.literal: Refugees in Jinan and Bin-Di were summoned to return.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees in Jinan and Bin-Di were called back to their homes.

sentences.zh: 遣使征諸路賦稅錢帛。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to collect taxes in money and silk from all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to collect tax payments in money and silk from every circuit.

sentences.zh: 民間所賣布帛有疏薄狹短者，禁之。

translations.literal: Cloth and silk sold among the people that was loose-woven, thin, or short in width was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The sale of loose-woven, thin, or narrow cloth and silk in private markets was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，初置隆興路驛。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuwu day, relays in the Longxing Route were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the tenth month of winter relay stations in Longxing circuit were established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，詔以歲不登，量減阿述、怯烈各軍行餉。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiashen day, an edict ordered that because the harvest had failed, field rations for the Ashu and Qielie armies be reduced proportionally.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the eleventh month an edict ordered field rations for the Ashu and Qielie armies cut proportionally because the harvest had failed.

sentences.zh: 東平、大名等路旱，量減今歲田租。

translations.literal: Dongping, Daming, and other circuits suffered drought; this year's field rent was reduced proportionally.
translations.idiomatic: Dongping, Daming, and other circuits suffered drought, and field rents for the year were cut proportionally.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，享於太廟，以合丹、塔察兒、王磐、張文謙行事。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, with Qidan, Tachar, Wang Pan, and Zhang Wenqian performing the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, with Qidan, Tachar, Wang Pan, and Zhang Wenqian conducting the rites.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃以免置驛、籍民等事，遣其臣韓就奉表來謝，賜中統五年曆並蜀錦一，仍命禃入朝。

translations.literal: King Wang Chon of Goryeo, on account of the abolition of relay stations and household registration and other matters, sent his minister Han Jiu with a memorial of thanks; the Zhongtong fifth-year calendar and one bolt of Shu brocade were granted, and Chon was also ordered to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Han Jiu with a memorial of thanks over the abolition of relay stations, household registration, and related measures; he received the fifth-year Zhongtong calendar and a bolt of Shu brocade, and was ordered to come to court.

sentences.zh: 立御衣、尚食二局。

translations.literal: The Imperial Garments Bureau and Imperial Provisions Bureau were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Garments Bureau and Imperial Provisions Bureau were established.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未朔，以鳳翔屯軍、汪惟正青居等軍、刁國器平陽軍，令益都元帥欽察統之，戍虎嘯寨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingwei new moon, the Fengxiang garrison troops, Wang Weizheng's Qingju army, and Diao Guoqi's Pingyang army were placed under Yidu Grand Marshal Qincha to garrison Huxiao Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the twelfth month the Fengxiang garrison, Wang Weizheng's Qingju force, and Diao Guoqi's Pingyang force were placed under Yidu Grand Marshal Qincha to garrison Huxiao Stockade.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，敕駙馬愛不花蒲萄戶依民例輸賦。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, an edict ordered the grape households of the imperial son-in-law Aibuhua to pay taxes according to the civilian rule.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict ordered the grape households of the imperial son-in-law Aibuhua to pay taxes on the same terms as civilians.

sentences.zh: 也裏可溫、答失蠻、僧、道種田入租，貿易輸稅。

translations.literal: Nestorian Christians, Dasman, monks, and Daoists who farmed land were to pay rent; those who traded were to pay tax.
translations.idiomatic: Nestorian Christians, Dasman, monks, and Daoists who farmed paid land rent, and those who traded paid commercial tax.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜諸王金、銀、幣、帛如歲例。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the princes were granted gold, silver, bolts, and silk according to the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day princes received gold, silver, bolts, and silk as in the annual custom.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶一百五十七萬九千一百一十；

translations.literal: That year throughout the empire there were 1,579,110 households;
translations.idiomatic: That year the empire registered 1,579,110 households;

sentences.zh: 賦，絲七十萬六千四百一斤，鈔四萬九千四百八十七錠；

translations.literal: In levies: 706,401 jin of silk and 49,487 ingots of notes;
translations.idiomatic: Levies came to 706,401 jin of silk and 49,487 ingots of notes;

sentences.zh: 斷死罪七人。

translations.literal: Seven persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Seven persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，賀福等六人告平陽、太原漏籍戶，詔賞以官，廷臣以非材對，給鈔與之。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinhai day, He Fu and five others reported unregistered households in Pingyang and Taiyuan; an edict offered official reward, but court ministers deemed them unqualified for office and paper money was given instead.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the second month He Fu and five others reported unregistered households in Pingyang and Taiyuan; the court offered official reward, but ministers judged them unfit for office and paid them in notes instead.

sentences.zh: 敕選儒士編修國史，譯寫經書，起館舍，給俸以贍之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the selection of Confucian scholars to compile the national history, translate the classics, establish halls of residence, and grant salaries for their support.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Confucian scholars chosen to compile the national history, translate the classics, and be housed and salaried for the work.

sentences.zh: 壬子，修瓊花島。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Qionghua Island was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Qionghua Island was restored.

sentences.zh: 發北京都元帥阿海所領軍疏雙塔漕渠。

translations.literal: The army under Beijing Grand Marshal Ahai was ordered to dredge the Shuangta grain canal.
translations.idiomatic: The army under Beijing Grand Marshal Ahai was ordered to dredge the Shuangta grain canal.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以故亳州千戶邸閏陷於宋，命其子榮祖襲職。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, because the late qianhu of Bozhou, Di Run, had been lost to the Song, his son Rongzu was ordered to succeed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, because the late qianhu of Bozhou, Di Run, had fallen to the Song, his son Rongzu was ordered to inherit the post.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，罷陜西行戶部。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the Shaanxi Branch Ministry of Revenue was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Shaanxi branch Ministry of Revenue was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon encroached on Nandou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon passed through Nandou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the imperial carriage went to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor went to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路總管史權等二十三人赴上都大朝會。

translations.literal: An edict ordered route administrators Shi Quan and twenty-two others to come to Shangdu for the great court assembly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned route administrators Shi Quan and twenty-two others to Shangdu for the great court assembly.

sentences.zh: 弛邊城軍器之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition on weapons in the border cities was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: The ban on weapons in the border cities was eased.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，設周天醮於長春宮。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengchen day, the Grand Heaven Ritual was established at Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the third month the Grand Heaven Ritual was instituted at Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命尚書宋子貞陳時事，子貞條具以聞，詔獎諭，命中書省議行之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Minister Song Zizhen was ordered to set forth current affairs; Zizhen submitted them item by item, an edict praised and encouraged him, and the Central Secretariat was ordered to deliberate and implement them.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Minister Song Zizhen was ordered to report on current affairs; he submitted a detailed list, received an edict of praise, and the Central Secretariat was told to deliberate and carry out his proposals.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔四川行院，命阿脫專掌軍政，其刑名錢谷商挺任之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, an edict to the Sichuan Branch Secretariat ordered Atu to take exclusive charge of military affairs, while Shang Ting would handle criminal cases, finances, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict to the Sichuan branch secretariat put Atu in sole charge of military affairs and left criminal cases, finances, and grain to Shang Ting.

sentences.zh: 立漕運司，以王光益為使。

translations.literal: The Grain Transport Commission was established, with Wang Guangyi as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The grain transport commission was established, with Wang Guangyi as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，以彰德、洺磁路引漳、滏、洹水灌田，致御河淺澀，鹽運不通，塞分渠以復水勢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wushen day, because the Zhangde and Ming-Ci circuits had drawn the Zhang, Fu, and Huan rivers to irrigate fields, causing the Imperial Canal to shoal and salt transport to be blocked, branch channels were filled in to restore the water flow.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the fourth month of summer, because Zhangde and Ming-Ci had diverted the Zhang, Fu, and Huan rivers to irrigate fields and left the Imperial Canal too shallow for salt transport, branch channels were blocked off to restore the current.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太陰犯軒轅御女星。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the moon encroached on the Woman star in the Xuanyuan asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the moon passed through the Woman star in Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，東平、太原、平陽旱，分遣西僧祈雨。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Dongping, Taiyuan, and Pingyang suffered drought; Western monks were dispatched separately to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Dongping, Taiyuan, and Pingyang suffered drought, and Western monks were sent out separately to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔高麗國王王禃來朝上都，修世見之禮。

translations.literal: On yimao day, an edict ordered King Wang Chon of Goryeo to come to Shangdu and perform the ceremony due from a vassal who attends in person.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict ordered King Wang Chon of Goryeo to come to Shangdu and perform the ceremony owed by a vassal attending in person.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以四川茶、鹽、商、酒、竹課充軍糧。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Sichuan tea, salt, commercial, wine, and bamboo levies were assigned to supply army grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Sichuan levies on tea, salt, commerce, wine, and bamboo were assigned to supply army grain.

sentences.zh: 楊大淵以部將王仲得宋將昝萬壽書殺之，詔以其事未經鞫問，或墮宋人行間之計，豈宜輒施刑戮，詰責大淵，仍存恤仲家。

translations.literal: Yang Dayuan, because his subordinate Wang Zhong had obtained a letter from the Song general Zan Wanshou and killed him, received an edict stating that since the matter had not yet been investigated, he might have fallen into a Song stratagem — how could execution be applied so rashly? Dayuan was rebuked, and Wang Zhong's family was still to be comforted.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Dayuan's subordinate Wang Zhong had killed a man after obtaining a letter from the Song general Zan Wanshou; an edict rebuked Dayuan, saying that without investigation he might have played into a Song ruse and should not have ordered execution so hastily, and Wang Zhong's family was to be compensated.

sentences.zh: 御苑官南家帶請修駐蹕涼樓並廣牧地，詔涼樓俟農隙，牧地分給農之無田者。

translations.literal: Nanjiadai, an official of the imperial park, requested repair of the imperial resting cool pavilion and expansion of pasture land; an edict ordered the cool pavilion deferred until an agricultural lull, and pasture land divided among farmers without fields.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjiadai, an imperial park official, asked to repair the imperial resting cool pavilion and expand pasture; the court deferred the pavilion until the farming slack season and ordered pasture land divided among landless farmers.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，追治李亶逆黨萬戶張邦直兄弟及姜郁、李在等二十七人罪。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the crimes of Zhang Bangzhi the wanhu, his brothers, and twenty-seven others including Jiang Yu and Li Zai, associates in Li Tan's rebellion, were pursued to judgment.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the cases of wanhu Zhang Bangzhi, his brothers, and twenty-seven others including Jiang Yu and Li Zai, associates in Li Tan's rebellion, were prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，給新附戍軍糧餉。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, grain rations were issued to newly submitted garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day grain rations were issued to newly submitted garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王禃遣其臣金祿來貢。

translations.literal: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Jin Lu bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Chon of Goryeo sent his minister Jin Lu with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，詔遣唆脫顏、郭守敬行視西夏河渠，俾具圖來上。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yihai day, an edict dispatched Suotuoyan and Guo Shoujing to inspect the river and canal works of Western Xia and submit maps.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the fifth month an edict sent Suotuoyan and Guo Shoujing to inspect Western Xia's river and canal works and submit maps.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，敕劍州守將分軍守劍門，置驛於人頭山。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, an edict ordered the Jian Prefecture garrison commander to divide troops to hold Jianmen and establish a relay at Rentou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered the Jian Prefecture garrison commander to detach troops for Jianmen and open a relay station at Rentou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, the moon encroached on Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon passed through Fang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，釋宋私商五十七人，給糧遣歸其國。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, fifty-seven private Song merchants were released, given grain, and sent home to their country.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day fifty-seven private Song merchants were freed, given grain, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以平陰縣尹馬欽發私粟六百石贍饑民，又給民粟種四百餘石，詔獎諭，特賜西錦一端以旌其義。

translations.literal: On jichou day, because Pingyin County Magistrate Ma Qin had issued six hundred shi of his private grain to feed starving people and also gave the people more than four hundred shi of seed grain, an edict praised and encouraged him and specially granted one bolt of western brocade to honor his righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Pingyin county magistrate Ma Qin was praised and rewarded with a bolt of western brocade for distributing six hundred shi of his own grain to the starving and more than four hundred shi of seed grain besides.

sentences.zh: 乙未，初置四川急遞鋪。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, express relay stations in Sichuan were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day express relay stations in Sichuan were established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜諸王欽察銀萬兩，濟其所部貧乏者。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, ten thousand taels of silver were granted to Prince Qincha to relieve the impoverished among his followers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Prince Qincha received ten thousand taels of silver to relieve the poor among his followers.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon encroached on Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon passed through Mao.

sentences.zh: 以中書右丞粘合南合為平章政事。

translations.literal: Nianhe Nanhe, Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat, was appointed Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Nianhe Nanhe, right vice director of the Central Secretariat, was made grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 邛部川六番安撫招討使都王明亞為鄰國建都所殺，敕其子伯佗襲職，賜金符。

translations.literal: Du Wang Mingya, Pacification and Pacification Commissioner of the Six Fan of Qiongbuchuan, was killed by Jiandu of the neighboring state; an edict ordered his son Botuo to succeed to the office and granted him a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: Du Wang Mingya, pacification and pacification commissioner of the Six Fan of Qiongbuchuan, was killed by Jiandu of the neighboring state; the court ordered his son Botuo to succeed him and granted a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，召王鶚、姚樞赴上都。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yisi day, Wang E and Yao Shu were summoned to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yisi day, Wang E and Yao Shu were summoned to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 宋制置夏貴率兵欲攻虎嘯山，敕以萬戶石抹糺劄剌一軍益欽察戍之。

translations.literal: Song Military Commissioner Xia Gui led troops intending to attack Huxiao Mountain; an edict ordered one army under wanhu Shimo Qočazha to reinforce Qincha's garrison there.
translations.idiomatic: Song Military Commissioner Xia Gui marched to attack Huxiao Mountain; the court ordered one army under wanhu Shimo Qočazha to reinforce Qincha's garrison.

sentences.zh: 戊申，高麗國王王禃來朝。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo came to court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，彗星出輿鬼，昏見西北，貫上臺，掃紫微、文昌及北斗，旦見東北，凡四十餘日。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu day, a comet appeared from the Ghost asterism; at dusk it was seen in the northwest, pierced the Upper Platform, swept through Purple Forbidden, Literary Glory, and the Northern Dipper, and at dawn was seen in the northeast — in all more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu day, a comet rose from the Ghost asterism; at dusk it showed in the northwest, cut through the Upper Platform, swept Purple Forbidden, Literary Glory, and the Northern Dipper, and at dawn appeared in the northeast — for more than forty days in all.

sentences.zh: 以阿合馬言，益解州鹽課，均賦諸色僧道軍匠等戶，其太原小鹽，聽從民便。

translations.literal: On Ahmad's recommendation, the salt levy of Jie Prefecture was increased, taxes were equalized among Buddhist and Daoist clergy, military artisan households, and the like; small-scale salt in Taiyuan was left to the people's convenience.
translations.idiomatic: On Ahmad's recommendation the salt levy of Jie Prefecture was raised, taxes were equalized across Buddhist and Daoist clergy, military artisan households, and similar categories, and small-scale salt production in Taiyuan was left to local convenience.

sentences.zh: 癸未，改新鳳州為徽州。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Xin Feng Prefecture was renamed Hui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Xin Feng Prefecture was renamed Hui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以西番十八族部立安西州，行安撫司事。

translations.literal: Anxi Prefecture was established for the eighteen tribes of the Western Barbarians, with the Pacification Commission administering its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi Prefecture was established for the eighteen tribes of the Western Barbarians, with a pacification commission placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，諸王算吉所部營帳軍民被火，發粟賑之。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, the encampments, military, and civilians under Prince Suanji suffered fire; grain was issued to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day fire destroyed the encampments, troops, and civilians under Prince Suanji; grain was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，給諸王也速不花印。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Prince Yesubuge was granted a seal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Yesubuge received a seal.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，特詔諭鞏昌路總帥汪惟正勞勉之，賜元寶交鈔三萬貫，仍戍青居。

translations.literal: On renchen day, a special edict addressed Wang Weizheng, commander of the Gongchang Route, with words of praise and encouragement, granted thirty thousand strings of Yuanbao paper notes, and ordered him to continue garrisoning Qingju.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day a special edict praised and encouraged Wang Weizheng, commander of the Gongchang route, granted him thirty thousand strings of Yuanbao paper notes, and ordered him to remain on garrison at Qingju.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王玉龍答失印，仍以先朝獵戶賜之。

translations.literal: Prince Yisibuge was granted a seal, and hunting households from the previous reign were also granted to him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yisibuge received a seal, along with hunting households granted from the previous reign.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，龍門禹廟成，命侍臣阿合脫因代祀。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the Yu Temple at Longmen was completed; the attendant minister Aqutayin was ordered to perform the sacrifice in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Yu Temple at Longmen was completed, and attendant minister Aqutayin was ordered to perform the sacrifice in the Emperor's place.

sentences.zh: 己亥，定用御寶制：凡宣命，一品、二品用玉，三品至五品用金。

translations.literal: On jihai day, regulations for the use of imperial seals were fixed: for all appointments and orders, ranks one and two used jade, ranks three to five used gold.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day rules for imperial seals were fixed: appointments and orders for ranks one and two used jade, ranks three through five used gold.

sentences.zh: 其文曰「皇帝行寶」者，即位時所鑄，惟用之詔誥；

translations.literal: That whose inscription read "Imperial Traveling Seal" was cast at accession and was used only for edicts and patents;
translations.idiomatic: The seal inscribed "Imperial Traveling Seal" was cast at accession and was reserved for edicts and patents;

sentences.zh: 別鑄宣命金寶行之。

translations.literal: A separate gold seal for appointments and orders was cast for that purpose.
translations.idiomatic: a separate gold seal for appointments and orders was cast for that use.

sentences.zh: 庚子，阿裏不哥自昔木土之敗，不復能軍，至是與諸王玉龍答失、阿速帶、昔裏給，其所謀臣不魯花、忽察、禿滿、阿裏察、脫忽思等來歸。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Ariq Böke, since his defeat at Shimultu, had been unable to maintain an army; now he came over together with Princes Yisibuge, Asudai, and Shirigin and their plotting ministers Buluqan, Qoča, Tumen, Ariqa, and Toqosi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Ariq Böke, unable to keep an army since his defeat at Shimultu, came over with Princes Yisibuge, Asudai, and Shirigin and their plotting ministers Buluqan, Qoča, Tumen, Ariqa, and Toqosi.

sentences.zh: 詔諸王皆太祖之裔，並釋不問，其謀臣不魯花等皆伏誅。

translations.literal: An edict stated that all princes were descendants of Taizu and were pardoned without question; their plotting ministers Buluqan and the others were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that all princes, as descendants of Taizu, were pardoned without inquiry; their plotting ministers Buluqan and the others were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅朔，陜西行省臣上言：「川蜀戍兵軍需，請令奧魯官征入官庫，移文於近戍官司，依數取之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the renyin new moon, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat officials memorialized: "For the military needs of Sichuan garrison troops, we ask that ordo offices collect revenue into government treasuries and issue documents to nearby garrison offices to take supplies according to quantity.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the eighth month, officials of the Shaanxi branch secretariat memorialized: "For the needs of Sichuan garrison troops, ordo offices should collect revenue into government treasuries and issue documents to nearby garrison offices to draw supplies in the proper amounts.

sentences.zh: 宋新附民宜撥地土衣糧，給其牛種，仍禁邊將分匿人口。

translations.literal: Newly submitted Song people should be allotted land, clothing, and grain, given oxen and seed, and frontier generals should be forbidden to conceal people in their households.
translations.idiomatic: Newly submitted Song people should receive land, clothing, and grain, be given oxen and seed, and frontier generals should be forbidden to hide people in their households.

sentences.zh: 商州險要，乞增戍兵。

translations.literal: Shang Prefecture is strategically vital; we ask that the garrison be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Prefecture is strategically vital; we ask that its garrison be reinforced.

sentences.zh: 陜西獵戶移獵商州。

translations.literal: Shaanxi hunting households should be moved to hunt at Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi hunting households should be transferred to hunt in Shang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河西、鳳翔屯田軍遷戍興元。

translations.literal: Garrison-farming troops of Hexi and Fengxiang should be transferred to garrison Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison-farming troops from Hexi and Fengxiang should be moved to garrison Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 四川各翼軍，有地者征其稅，給無田者糧。

translations.literal: For each wing army in Sichuan, those with land should pay tax, and those without land should receive grain.
translations.idiomatic: For each wing army in Sichuan, households with land should pay tax and those without land should receive grain.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were granted.
translations.idiomatic: " All were approved.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔秦蜀行省發銀二十五萬兩給沿邊歲用。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, an edict ordered the Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat to issue two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver for the annual expenses of the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Qin-Shu branch secretariat was ordered to release two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver for annual frontier expenses.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，立山東諸路行中書省，以中書左丞相耶律鑄、參知政事張惠等行省事。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the Shandong Branch Central Secretariat was established, with Left Grand Councillor Yelü Zhuo, Vice Administrator Zhang Hui, and others administering branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Shandong branch central secretariat was established, with Left Grand Councillor Yelü Zhuo, Vice Administrator Zhang Hui, and others to run its affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔新立條格：省并州縣，定官吏員數，分品從官職，給俸祿，頒公田，計月日以考殿最；

translations.literal: An edict promulgated new regulations: prefectures and counties were to be consolidated, official posts and numbers fixed, ranks and duties assigned, salaries granted, public fields distributed, and monthly and yearly performance assessed;
translations.idiomatic: An edict promulgated new regulations: consolidate prefectures and counties, fix official posts and numbers, assign ranks and duties, grant salaries, distribute public fields, and assess performance by month and year;

sentences.zh: 均賦役，招流移；

translations.literal: equalize taxes and corvée, and recruit displaced people;
translations.idiomatic: equalize taxes and corvée and recruit displaced people;

sentences.zh: 禁勿擅用官物，勿以官物進獻，勿借易官錢；

translations.literal: forbid unauthorized use of government goods, presenting government goods as tribute, or borrowing and exchanging government funds;
translations.idiomatic: forbid unauthorized use of government property, presenting government goods as tribute, or borrowing and trading government funds;

sentences.zh: 勿擅科差役；

translations.literal: forbid unauthorized levies and corvée;
translations.idiomatic: forbid unauthorized levies and corvée;

sentences.zh: 凡軍馬不得停泊村坊，詞訟不得隔越陳訴；

translations.literal: troops and horses must not be quartered in villages and wards, and lawsuits must not be appealed across jurisdictions;
translations.idiomatic: troops and horses must not be quartered in villages and wards, and lawsuits must not bypass proper jurisdiction;

sentences.zh: 恤鰥寡，勸農桑，驗雨澤，平物價；

translations.literal: relieve widows and orphans, encourage farming and sericulture, inspect rainfall, and stabilize prices;
translations.idiomatic: relieve widows and orphans, encourage farming and sericulture, inspect rainfall, and stabilize prices;

sentences.zh: 具盜賦、囚徒起數，月申省部。

translations.literal: record numbers of robberies and prisoners and report monthly to the secretariat and ministries.
translations.idiomatic: record robberies and prisoners and report monthly to the secretariat and ministries.

sentences.zh: 又頒陜西四川、西夏中興、北京三處行中書條格。

translations.literal: Regulations for the branch secretariats at Shaanxi-Sichuan, Western Xia Zhongxing, and Beijing were also promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for the branch secretariats at Shaanxi-Sichuan, Western Xia Zhongxing, and Beijing were also issued.

sentences.zh: 定立諸王使臣驛傳稅賦差發，不許擅招民戶，不得以銀與非投下人為斡脫，禁口傳敕旨及追呼省臣官屬。

translations.literal: Regulations were fixed for princes' envoys, relay transport, taxes, levies, and corvée; unauthorized recruitment of households was forbidden, silver might not be lent through otog offices to persons outside appanages, oral transmission of edicts was forbidden, and summoning secretariat officials by princes was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Rules were fixed for princes' envoys, relay transport, taxes, levies, and corvée; princes might not recruit households on their own, lend silver through otog offices to persons outside appanages, pass edicts by word of mouth, or summon secretariat officials.

sentences.zh: 詔：「蒙古戶種田，有馬牛羊之家，其糧住支；

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Among Mongol households farming fields, those with horses, cattle, and sheep shall have their grain rations stopped;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Among Mongol households who farm, those with horses, cattle, and sheep shall cease receiving grain rations;

sentences.zh: 無田者仍給之。

translations.literal: those without fields shall still receive them.
translations.idiomatic: those without fields shall still receive rations.

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，命燕王署敕、諸王設僚屬及說書官。

translations.literal: " On gengxu day, the Prince of Yan was ordered to sign edicts; princes were to establish staff and lecturing officers.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengxu day the Prince of Yan was ordered to sign edicts, and princes were told to establish staff and lecturing officers.

sentences.zh: 諸站戶限田四頃免稅，供驛馬及祗應；

translations.literal: Relay-station households were limited to four qing of tax-exempt land to supply relay horses and attendants;
translations.idiomatic: Relay-station households were granted four qing of tax-exempt land to supply relay horses and attendants;

sentences.zh: 命各路總管府兼領其事。

translations.literal: route chief administrators were ordered concurrently to oversee the matter.
translations.idiomatic: route chief administrators were ordered to oversee the matter concurrently.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命僧子聰同議樞密院事。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the monk Zizong was ordered to deliberate jointly on Bureau of Military Affairs affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the monk Zizong was ordered to join in deliberations at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔子聰復其姓劉氏，易名秉忠，拜太保，參領中書省事。

translations.literal: An edict restored Zizong to his surname Liu, changed his name to Bingzhong, invested him as Grand Preceptor, and made him participate in directing Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored Zizong to the surname Liu, changed his name to Bingzhong, invested him as grand preceptor, and made him participate in directing Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔改燕京為中都，其大興府仍舊。

translations.literal: On yimao day, an edict changed Yanjing to Zhongdu; Daxing Prefecture remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict renamed Yanjing Zhongdu; Daxing Prefecture remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 增都省參佐掾史月俸。

translations.literal: Monthly salaries of secretariat assistant clerks were increased.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly salaries for secretariat assistant clerks were raised.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，劉秉忠、王鶚、張文謙、商挺言，燕王既署相銜，宜於省中別置幕位，每月一再至，判署朝政。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Liu Bingzhong, Wang E, Zhang Wenqian, and Shang Ting stated that since the Prince of Yan already held the chancellorship, a separate office should be set up within the secretariat where he would come once or twice a month to decide and sign state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Liu Bingzhong, Wang E, Zhang Wenqian, and Shang Ting argued that since the Prince of Yan already held the chancellorship, the secretariat should set up a separate office where he would come once or twice a month to decide and sign state affairs.

sentences.zh: 其說書官，皇子忙安以李磐為之，南木合以高道為之。

translations.literal: For lecturing officers, the prince Mang'an was given Li Pan, and Namuhe was given Gao Dao.
translations.idiomatic: As lecturing officers, Prince Mang'an was given Li Pan and Prince Namuhe was given Gao Dao.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以改元大赦天下，詔曰：

translations.literal: On dingsi day, on the occasion of changing the era name, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the edict stated:
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, on changing the era name, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the edict stated:

sentences.zh: 戊午，給益都武衛軍千人冬衣。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, winter clothing was granted to one thousand men of the Yidu Wuwei Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day one thousand men of the Yidu Wuwei Guard received winter clothing.

sentences.zh: 己未，鳳翔府龍泉寺僧超過等謀亂遇赦，沒其財，羈管京兆僧司；

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Chaoguo and others, monks of Longquan Temple in Fengxiang Prefecture, had plotted rebellion but encountered the amnesty; their property was confiscated and they were placed under restraint by the Jingzhao Buddhist office;
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Chaoguo and other monks of Longquan Temple in Fengxiang Prefecture, though they had plotted rebellion, encountered the amnesty; their property was confiscated and they were placed under restraint by the Jingzhao Buddhist office;

sentences.zh: 同謀蘇德，責令從軍自效。

translations.literal: Su De, a co-conspirator, was ordered to serve in the army to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: Su De, a co-conspirator, was ordered to serve in the army to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 發萬戶石抹糺劄剌所部千人赴商州屯田，亳州軍六百八人及河南府軍六十人助欽察戍青居。

translations.literal: One thousand men under wanhu Shimo Qočazha were sent to farm at Shang Prefecture; six hundred eight Bozhou troops and sixty Henan Prefecture troops were sent to help Qincha garrison Qingju.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand men under wanhu Shimo Qočazha were sent to farm at Shang Prefecture, while six hundred eight Bozhou troops and sixty Henan Prefecture troops were sent to reinforce Qincha at Qingju.

sentences.zh: 敕山東經略副使武秀選益都新軍千人充武衛軍，赴中都。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Shandong Frontier Deputy Commissioner Wu Xiu to select one thousand new troops from Yidu to fill the Wuwei Guard and march them to Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Shandong frontier deputy commissioner Wu Xiu to select one thousand new Yidu troops for the Wuwei Guard and march them to Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 城郯，以沂州監戰塔思、萬戶孟義所部兵戍之。

translations.literal: Tan city was walled, and troops under Yizhou battle overseer Tasi and wanhu Meng Yi were stationed to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Tan was walled, and troops under Yizhou battle overseer Tasi and wanhu Meng Yi were posted to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 太原路總管攸忙兀帶坐藏甲匿戶，罷職為民。

translations.literal: You Mangwudai, chief administrator of the Taiyuan Route, was dismissed from office and reduced to commoner status for concealing armor and hiding households.
translations.idiomatic: You Mangwudai, chief administrator of the Taiyuan route, was dismissed and reduced to commoner status for concealing armor and hiding households.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申朔，立翰林國史院。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the renshen new moon, the Hanlin Imperial History Academy was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen new moon of the ninth month the Hanlin Imperial History Academy was established.

sentences.zh: 以改元詔諭高麗國，並赦其境內。

translations.literal: The edict on changing the era name was sent to instruct Goryeo, and amnesty was also granted within its territory.
translations.idiomatic: The era-change edict was sent to instruct Goryeo, and amnesty was also granted within its territory.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，車駕至自上都。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，益都毛璋謀逆，二子及其黨崔成並伏誅，籍其家貲，賜行省撒吉思。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Mao Zhang of Yidu plotted rebellion; his two sons and his follower Cui Cheng were all executed, his household property was confiscated, and it was granted to Branch Secretariat Governor Sagis.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mao Zhang of Yidu plotted rebellion; his two sons and follower Cui Cheng were executed, his property confiscated, and granted to branch secretariat governor Sagis.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅朔，高麗國王王禃來朝。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the renyin new moon, the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the tenth month of winter King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo came to court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禁上都畿內捕獵。

translations.literal: On yisi day, hunting within the Shangdu metropolitan region was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day hunting within the Shangdu metropolitan region was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，有事於太廟。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬子，恩州歷亭縣進嘉禾，一莖五穗。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Liting County in En Prefecture presented auspicious grain, one stalk with five ears.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Liting County in En Prefecture presented auspicious grain, one stalk bearing five ears.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，改武衛軍為侍衛親軍。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the Wuwei Guard was renamed the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Wuwei Guard was renamed the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，詔宋人歸順及北人陷沒來歸者，皆月給糧食。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi day, an edict ordered that Song people who submitted and northerners captured by the enemy who came over should all receive monthly grain rations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the eleventh month an edict ordered monthly grain rations for Song people who submitted and northerners captured by the enemy who returned.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，征骨嵬。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Kuryu was attacked.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day an expedition was launched against Kuryu.

sentences.zh: 先是，吉裏迷內附，言其國東有骨嵬、亦裏於兩部，歲來侵疆，故往征之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Gilyak submitted, they reported that east of their country were the two tribes of Kuryu and Yiliyu, which each year invaded their borders; hence the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Gilyak submitted, they reported that east of their country lay the two tribes of Kuryu and Yiliyu, which raided their borders every year; hence the expedition.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以至元二年曆日賜高麗國王王禃。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the calendar for the second year of the Zhiyuan era was granted to the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the calendar for the second year of the Zhiyuan era was granted to King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 禁登州、和州等處並女直人入高麗界剽掠。

translations.literal: Jurchen from Dengzhou, He Prefecture, and other places were forbidden to cross into Goryeo to plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen from Dengzhou, He Prefecture, and other places were forbidden to cross into Goryeo to raid.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，召衛州太一五代度師李居壽赴闕。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Li Jushou, fifth-generation lineage master of the Taiyi sect in Weizhou, was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Li Jushou, fifth-generation lineage master of the Taiyi sect in Weizhou, was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷領中書左右部，並入中書省。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the Left and Right Departments of the Central Secretariat were abolished and merged into the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the left and right departments of the Central Secretariat were abolished and merged into the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以領中書省左右部兼諸路都轉運使、知太府監事阿合馬為平章政事，領中書省左右部兼諸路都轉運使阿裏為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Ahmad, who headed the Left and Right Departments of the Central Secretariat and concurrently served as Commissioner of Transport for All Routes and Director of the Imperial Storehouse, was made Grand Councillor; Ali, who headed the Left and Right Departments and concurrently served as Commissioner of Transport for All Routes, was made Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad, head of the left and right departments of the Central Secretariat and concurrent commissioner of transport for all routes and director of the imperial storehouse, was made grand councillor; Ali, head of the left and right departments and concurrent commissioner of transport for all routes, was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太原路臨州進嘉禾二莖。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Lin Prefecture in the Taiyuan Route presented auspicious grain with two stalks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Lin Prefecture in the Taiyuan route presented auspicious grain with two stalks.

sentences.zh: 以元帥按敦、劉整、劉元禮、欽察等將士獲功，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: Marshals Andun, Liu Zheng, Liu Yuanli, Qincha, and other officers and soldiers who had won merit were rewarded in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Marshals Andun, Liu Zheng, Liu Yuanli, Qincha, and other officers and soldiers who had won merit received rewards in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，罷各投下達魯花赤，定中外百官儀從。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yisi day, darughachi of each appanage were abolished, and ceremonial precedence for officials at court and abroad was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the twelfth month darughachi of each appanage were abolished, and ceremonial precedence for officials at court and abroad was fixed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，敕遣宋諜者四人還其國。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, an edict ordered four Song spies sent back to their country.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict ordered four Song spies sent back to their country.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賞拔都軍人銀五十萬兩。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, five hundred thousand taels of silver were granted to reward the Badu army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day five hundred thousand taels of silver were granted to reward the Badu army.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the moon infringed upon Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon infringed upon Fang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以王鑒昔使大理沒於王事，其子天赦不能自存，優恤之。

translations.literal: On yichou day, because Wang Jian had formerly been envoy to Dali and died in the service of the state, and his son Tianshe could not support himself, special relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, because Wang Jian had died on mission to Dali in the service of the state and his son Tianshe could not support himself, special relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，敕鄧州沿邊增立茱萸、常平、建陵、季陽四堡。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, an edict ordered four forts — Zhuyu, Changping, Jianling, and Jiyang — established along the Deng Prefecture frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict ordered four forts — Zhuyu, Changping, Jianling, and Jiyang — established along the Deng Prefecture frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命選善水者一人，沿黃河計水程達東勝可通漕運，馳驛以聞。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, an order was issued to select one skilled in waterworks to measure the course of the Yellow River as far as Dongsheng to see whether grain transport could pass, and report by relay post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court ordered one skilled in waterworks to survey the Yellow River as far as Dongsheng to determine whether grain transport could pass, and report by relay post.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔罷樞密院斷事官及各路奧魯官，令總管府兼總押所。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict abolished the adjudication officers of the Bureau of Military Affairs and ordo offices on all routes, ordering chief administrators concurrently to oversee general custody offices.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict abolished the adjudication officers of the Bureau of Military Affairs and route ordo offices, ordering chief administrators concurrently to oversee general custody offices.

sentences.zh: 始罷諸侯世守，立遷轉法。

translations.literal: Hereditary tenure by feudal lords was abolished for the first time, and a rotation system was established.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary tenure by feudal lords was abolished for the first time and a rotation system established.

sentences.zh: 是歲，真定、順天、洺、磁、順德、大名、東平、曹、濮州、泰安、高唐、濟州、博州、德州、濟南、濱、棣、淄、萊、河間大水。

translations.literal: That year, Zhending, Shuntian, Ming, Ci, Shunde, Daming, Dongping, Cao, Pu, Tai'an, Gaotang, Ji, Bo, De, Jinan, Bin, Di, Zi, Lai, and Hejian suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhending, Shuntian, Ming, Ci, Shunde, Daming, Dongping, Cao, Pu, Tai'an, Gaotang, Ji, Bo, De, Jinan, Bin, Di, Zi, Lai, and Hejian suffered major floods.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金、銀、幣帛如歲例。

translations.literal: Gold, silver, and silks were granted to the princes according to the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: Gold, silver, and silks were granted to the princes according to annual custom.

sentences.zh: 戶一百五十八萬八千一百九十五，斷死罪七十三人。

translations.literal: Households numbered one million five hundred eighty-eight thousand one hundred ninety-five; seventy-three persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: The registered population stood at one million five hundred eighty-eight thousand one hundred ninety-five households; seventy-three persons were sentenced to death.
